jobs.title: Program Coordinator - San Jose, CA
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

As a CBRE Program Coordinator, you will provide basic administrative and logistical support to the program team. This includes project documentation preparation, scheduling meetings and communication, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, tracking project progress, and assisting with financial reconciliation.

This role is part of the Center of Excellence Team. The team is responsible for the management of programs from initiation through completion.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Schedule meetings and communication plans regarding programs amongst teams and stakeholders.
* Assist with contract administration and account governance. This includes attending meetings, preparing correspondence, and tracking deliverables.
* Enter program information and data into program management technology tools.
* Process documentation for program commitments. Obtain external quotes for processing. Coordinate change orders, change directives and contemplate change notices with vendors and stakeholders.
* Track program milestones, budgets, and resources. Prepare and distribute regular program status reports.
* Process invoices and expense reports. Assist with program financial administration and reconciliation.
* Assist the program closeout process including turnover documentation and financial reconciliation.
* Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.
* Deliver own output by following defined procedures and processes under close supervision and guidance.

**What You’ll Need:**

* High School Diploma or GED with up to 2 years of job-related experience.
* Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
* Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
* Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

**Why CBRE?**

When you join CBRE, you become part of a global leader in commercial real estate and investment services that help businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact! Our collaborative environment is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service, and excellence — and we value the varied perspectives, backgrounds, and skills of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your full potential!

**Applicant AI Use Disclosure:**

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

These updates reflect our commitment to clarity, inclusivity, and a consistent candidate experience across all postings.

**Disclaimers**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

**Our Values in Hiring**

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Program Coordinator position is $44,500 annually [or $21,40 per hour] and the maximum salary for the Program Coordinator position is $85,000 annually [or $40,86 per hour]. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.

 **Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  
  
**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Account Manager, Lyft Ads
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Account Manager, you'll report to the West Coast Account Management Lead and serve as a strategic partner to Account Executives on multiple books of advertiser and agency accounts. You'll own campaigns from pitch through wrap, act as the main day-to-day contact for clients post-sale, and work across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, Data, and other teams to deliver strong results. You'll also help improve the processes and tools our sales team relies on. We're looking for someone who loves solving interesting problems, works well with autonomy, and cares deeply about client success and growth.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Pre-sales planning: Partner with Account Executives on RFP responses and media plans, including inventory forecasting, takeover/events calendar checks, and recommending the right mix of products to meet client goals.
* Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs, and flag gaps or risks early.
* Post-sales execution: Own all post-sale work for your book of business, including contract execution, creative services, and campaign reporting.
* Cross-functional liaison: Act as the point of contact between clients and Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams, resolving issues independently and escalating when needed.
* Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct campaigns via internal planning tools and ad server, including ticketing, setup, scheduling, pacing, and full delivery against Insertion Order terms. Proactively recommend optimizations to improve performance.
* Measurement and reporting: Build campaign and wrap reports, turn results into clear insights and next-step recommendations, and lead measurement studies where applicable.
* Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and make sure invoices are accurate and delivered on time.
* Client relationships: Own day-to-day client and agency relationships post-sale. Lead check-ins and wrap meetings, and partner with the AE to identify renewal and upsell opportunities.

**Experience:**
---------------

* BA/BS degree and 3-5 years of experience in digital advertising account management, media planning, or campaign management.
* Experience managing client and agency relationships directly and owning a book of business.
* Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Outstanding attention to detail.
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns across the full ad lifecycle at once, with minimal oversight.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.
* Self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $77,600 - $97,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

* Assist with departmental priorities and projects as required.

* Bachelor's degree in business, Data Science, or other relevant field

jobs.title: Pharmacy Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
  
Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day-to-day non-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, supervising pharmacy technicians and pharmacy cashiers within the guidelines of authorized company policies, laws, regulations and business ethics. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Company asset protection techniques. Supports Pharmacy Manager with diversion monitoring and reports any concerns that would compromise the security of the pharmacy to the Pharmacy Manager.
* Communicates prescription errors to the accountable pharmacist, and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Continuous Quality Improvement Program.
* Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and conducts or participates in 3rd party audit.
* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and trainin

jobs.title: Jr. Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Jr. Project Manager / Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer**

**Location:** San Francisco International Airport (SFO), San Francisco, CA  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Project-Based)  
**Work Schedule:** On-site minimum four (4) days per week  
**Industry:** Aviation Construction / Public Works Construction

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Jr. Project Manager** / **Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer** to support a major construction project at San Francisco International Airport (SFO). This position will be responsible for project documentation management, compliance tracking, administrative coordination, and support of offsite warehouse, field, and project management teams.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale public works or government-funded construction projects and possess a strong understanding of construction documentation processes, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, pay applications, certified payroll reporting, and contract compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Documentation & Controls**

* Maintain and manage project document control systems in accordance with contract requirements.
* Coordinate and track:
  + Requests for Information (RFIs)
  + Submittals and shop drawing reviews
  + Change Orders and Potential Change Orders (PCOs)
  + Meeting minutes and action item logs
  + Contract correspondence and transmittals
* Ensure timely distribution, tracking, and archival of project documentation.
* Maintain current drawing, specification, and revision logs.

**Contract Administration Support**

* Assist Project Managers and Superintendents with contract compliance and documentation requirements.
* Support preparation and tracking of monthly owner pay applications through the collection of required documents such as lien waivers, supporting invoices, and releases needed from subcontractors and/or suppliers.
* Verify completeness of required documentation prior to invoice processing.
* Monitor compliance with project specifications and contractual reporting requirements.
* Responsible for taking meeting minutes and distributing to team members.

**Public Works & Labor Compliance**

* Administer certified payroll documentation in accordance with California prevailing wage requirements.
* Coordinate payroll reporting and labor compliance tracking using LCPtracker or equivalent systems.
* Support audits and requests from labor compliance officers, funding agencies, and project stakeholders.
* Maintain records related to prevailing wage compliance and subcontractor reporting.

**SFO Site Administration**

* Coordinate badging, security clearance, and access requests in accordance with SFO requirements.
* Assist project personnel, subcontractors, and visitors with airport access procedures.
* Maintain records of security training, badging status, and site access documentation.
* Collect and distribute subcontractors’ site daily reports.
* Interface with airport administrative staff regarding project documentation and compliance requirements.

**Software & Reporting**

* Maintain project records using:
  + Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + ProjectSight
  + Procore
* Generate project logs, status reports, document tracking reports, and compliance reports.
* Support project team meetings and reporting requirements.

**Warehouse Logistics & Material Documentation**

* Coordinate and maintain documentation related to project materials, equipment, and warehouse inventory supporting construction activities.
* Track material procurement, deliveries, receiving records, storage locations, and distribution to field crews.
* Maintain material status logs and reconcile delivery records against purchase orders, packing slips, and subcontractor requests.
* Coordinate documentation for off-site warehouse operations, including inventory tracking and material movement records.
* Track long-lead materials and critical equipment to support project schedules and installation milestones.
* Maintain chain-of-custody and accountability documentation for contractor-procured materials.
* Support project teams with material expediting reports, delivery schedules, warehouse inventory records, and shortage/damage reporting.
* Coordinate with procurement, field supervision, subcontractors, and warehouse personnel to ensure accurate and timely documentation of material logistics activities.
* Utilize project management platforms such as Procore and ProjectSight to maintain material tracking logs and warehouse documentation records.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in construction administration, document control, office engineering, or project coordination.
* Experience supporting commercial, infrastructure, aviation, transportation, or public works construction projects.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Construction submittal processes
  + Request for Information (RFI) workflows
  + Change Order administration
  + Project specifications and contract documents
  + Payment application and waiver documentation processes
* Experience with California public works and government-funded projects.
* Familiarity with California certified payroll requirements and prevailing wage compliance.
* Experience utilizing LCPtracker or similar labor compliance management systems.
* Experience with construction material management, warehouse logistics coordination, inventory tracking, and receiving documentation.
* Understanding of construction procurement workflows, material delivery coordination, and warehouse record management.
* Ability to maintain accurate material tracking logs and support project-level reporting for procurement and logistics activities.
* Must be able to pass a background check for badging at SFO.
* Proficiency with:
  + Microsoft Office Suite
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + Procore
  + ProjectSight

*

jobs.title: New Product Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**New Product Project Manager**
-------------------------------

Bring structure, urgency, and cross-functional coordination to new semiconductor product introductions. As a New Product Project Manager, you’ll guide assembly and test activities from design planning through design verification and production release, helping ensure new products move through manufacturing efficiently, meet quality expectations, and ship on schedule. You’ll partner closely with engineering, operations, materials, planning, customer service, and program management, with significant ownership and minimal supervision.

### **What you'll do**

* Plan and coordinate new-product assembly and test activities from design planning through production release.
* Develop build sequences, manufacturing schedules, milestones, and material requirements.
* Partner with engineering and program teams to ensure manufacturing requirements are accurately reflected in Material Requirements Planning systems.
* Coordinate with planners, operations, materials, and customer service to keep builds moving against commitments.
* Adjust schedules in response to design changes, material or labor constraints, backlogs, and other changing conditions.
* Identify schedule risks, expedite delayed activities, and coordinate mitigation plans.
* Track project status, milestones, schedule performance, risks, decisions, actions, and owners.
* Maintain accurate order, amendment, shipping, and project documentation.
* Help ensure products meet company quality standards and delivery commitments.

### **What you need**

* Strong project planning, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills - **required**
* Ability to manage changing priorities and work independently in a manufacturing environment - **required**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience - **required**
* At least 5 years of directly related experience and/or training - **required**
* Semiconductor processing and radio frequency/microwave design or manufacturing experience - **preferred**
* Experience with MIL-STD-883 and basic knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100 - **preferred**
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen; Project Management Professional certification - **preferred**
* Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project proficiency, plus ability to travel domestically/internationally approximately 10% - **required**

### **What we offer**

An opportunity to take ownership of technically complex new-product builds, collaborate across engineering and manufacturing disciplines, and directly influence schedule, quality, and successful production release.

### **What happens next**

Submit your application for consideration. Details regarding the interview stages and candidate communications should be added once the recruiting process is confirmed.

*U.S. citizenship and the ability to attain and maintain a government security clearance are required. An active government security clearance is preferred. The role must follow applicable import/export requirements.*

**Salary Range:**

$141,900.00-$189,200.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Seeking a top-tier Assistant Project Manager for high-end residential construction

Are you looking for a challenge and opportunity to grow? Are you interested in working on architecturally-driven, high-end residential projects throughout Northern California? FORMA Construction, an award-winning firm, seeks a motivated, detail-oriented Assistant Project Manager to help build the most complex and detailed projects.

The Assistant Project Manager role is a critical hub for FORMA. In coordination with the Project Manager and the Superintendent; the APM works closely with clients, architects, designers, subcontractors, and other vendors. The APM tracks progress and updates budgets while keeping the project well-documented and running smoothly ensuring that our clients are informed and consulted every step of the way.

Success in this role is measured by your ability to maintain project documents like RFI's and Submittals among other tasks within Procore while maintaining good relations with our clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.

At FORMA, our Mission is the continual development of our people and processes to create lasting relationships built on integrity, partnership, and craft. Our core values are based on building relationships, collaborating to create the best possible outcomes, mutual respect, continued growth, and excellent craftsmanship. FORMA’s clients and work sites take us throughout the greater Bay Area, building a range of styles and requirements, but all our projects share the same level of dedication, detail, and communication. Our Assistant Project Manager will ensure that our clients receive the best possible service, while continuing to build their experience in project management.

**Responsibilities**:

* Assist with document control including RFI’s, submittals, subcontractor bids and documentation, change orders, schedule updates, drawings, and meeting minutes.

* Coordinate on site project set up, ensuring basic office supplies, safety equipment, required postings, toilets and utilities are in place for the project.

Finance - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For Infra, our focus is on providing tooling for visibility across the life cycle of data center infrastructure that feeds accurate accounting and finance records. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations.

**About the Role**

As Program Manageration, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, construction, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery.

You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption.
* Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths.
* Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance.
* Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review.
* Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs.
* Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments.
* Partner with applications, with monitoring and governed change controls.
* Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact.
* Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* 8+ years of experience in project or program managementation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments.
* Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting.
* Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.
* A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design.
* Fluency in data dependenciess.
* Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership.

The Port of San Francisco is an enterprise agency of the City and County of San Francisco and is governed by a Commission of five members appointed by the Mayor. The Port Commission is responsible for overseeing a broad range of waterfront commercial, maritime, and public access facilities that are held in public trust for the people of California. The Port’s jurisdiction covers approximately 7.5 miles of waterfront land from Pier 98, near Hunter’s Point in the southern part of San Francisco, to Fisherman’s Wharf in the northern part of the City.  
  
The Port’s diverse business portfolio includes over 550 ground, commercial, retail, office, industrial and maritime industrial leases including cargo shipping, layberthing, excursion boats, ferry boats, fishing and fish processing/distribution, tourism, filming, harbor services, and cruise operations. **About the Role**  
  
Uber is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Tech (L5) to lead LLM quality and evaluation programs across multilingual products and AI-powered experiences. You will define how we measure model quality, identify failures, and determine whether AI solutions are ready for production.  
  
Working across Engineering, LLMOps within the Localization Technology team, Multilingual Program manager, Product, and vendors, you will build, assess or improve the existing evaluation frameworks that validate model performance by language, market, content type, cultural nuance, and audiences. This role requires strong technical fluency in LLM behavior, understanding NLP, and the program leadership to turn evaluation findings into measurable improvements.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* **Own the LLM quality and evaluation roadmap.** Define program goals, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and release criteria across models and use cases.
* **Build scalable evaluation frameworks.** Establish statistically defensible methods to assess accuracy such as recall and precision, relevance, completeness, instruction following, linguistic quality, and cultural appropriateness.
* **Develop high-quality evaluation datasets.** Lead the creation, annotation, adjudication, versioning, and maintenance of golden datasets that represent real user needs, challenging scenarios, and multilingual requirements.
* **Evaluate model and system failures.** Partner with technical teams to assess hallucinations, prompt-injection susceptibility, unsupported claims, context loss, and inconsistent outputs. Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and citation accuracy.
* **Lead human and automated evaluation.** Establish reviewer guidelines, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems against expert assessments, and measure agreement, false positives, false negatives, and severity classification.
* **Drive model fitness decisions.** Collaborating with LLMOpn in the Localization Technology team to compare models and configurations by locale, task, quality, cost, and latency to inform model selection, routing, and deployment.
* **Close the quality improvement loop.** Translate findings into prioritized improvements to prompts, retrieval, terminology, workflows, and model configurations. Partner with owners to verify fixes and prevent regressions.
* **Operationalize continuous quality monitoring.** Establish regression testing, production sampling, quality dashboards, escalation processes, and ongoing evaluation as models and user needs evolve.
* **Lead cross-functional execution.** Clarify ownership, resolve dependencies, communicate risks, and align stakeholders on quality tradeoffs and launch readiness.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Operations, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Experience leading complex technical programs involving AI/ML, software platforms, quality engineering, or data-driven products.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver cross-functional programs with Engineering, Localization team, Data Scientist, Product, and Operations.
* Working understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, including hallucinations, prompt engineering, prompt injection, RAG, context management, and tool use.
* Experience designing quality metrics, evaluation methodologies, human-review workflows, or experimental programs.
* Ability to interpret statistical results, assess dataset quality, and communicate the limitations of evaluation findings to leaderships and LLMOps.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and written communication skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into executable plans.
* Experience evaluating multilingual LLMs, machine translation, conversational AI, or localization quality.
* Familiarity with MQM-based evaluation, terminology governance, and market-specific linguistic requirements.
* Experience with LLM evaluation platforms, automated regression pipelines, and production observability.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, APIs, and data pipelines sufficient to investigate results and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
* Experience evaluating multimodal systems, including text, image, audio, or video.
* Experience establishing quality standards and launch criteria for AI systems operating at scale.

  
For Sunnyvale/San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $167,000 per year - USD $185,000 per year.  
  
You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

This role will work cross-functionally with Supply Chain Procurement, Supply Chain Business Operations, Technical Sourcing, Quality Engineering, Hardware Engineering, and IT to gather requirements, select and implement tools, address pain points, and facilitate process documentation to enable the business to scale.
  
  
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

**Project Manager**

At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

**About Us:**

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

They will have experience managing project teams including themselves and three or more other engineering resources. They will have the ability to manage multiple projects totaling more than $600K in engineering services annually. This individual will be solely responsible for overseeing all phases of projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and exceptional client experience. This role requires strong leadership, proactive communication, and the ability to foster long-term client relationships while driving new business opportunities.

---------------

We are looking for a hands-on and highly motivated individual to support growing robotics operations in our Kings Cross lab. In this role, you will work on various operations projects to help scale our workflows, organise our space and lead the end-to-end deployment of new robotic platforms.

Who We Are Looking For

* A Self-Starter

* This is a fast paced environment, we need to know that you’re ready to dive in and put together plans that can be executed.

* Hands On Approach

* You love building a plan on paper, but you get even more excited about rolling up your sleeves to execute it physically.

* A Change-Maker

* We are continuously looking to improve the team and each other so we are looking to bring someone in who can continuously look to bring positive changes to the group.

* Supportive by Nature

* We all encounter challenges and provide mutual support to each other - job titles don't matter when we work together to achieve a common goal.

* Communication

* You will need to be able to communicate clearly to our team and stakeholders on the status of work and timelines for completion.

------------------------

* End-to-End Rollouts: Lead the planning, coordination, and physical execution of bringing new robotic platforms into and out of the facility.

* Logistics Management: Coordinate vendor deliveries, unboxing, and physical setup while ensuring minimal disruption to the existing workspace.

* Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with engineers to ensure facility floor plans are agreed upon and infrastructure requirements (power, network, space) are met before arrival.

* Requirement Tracking: Ensure all operational and technical requirements for each robotic platform are explicitly documented.

* Space Readiness: Maintain a world-class, organized, and safety-compliant lab space ready for daily engineering and research use.

* Workshop Operations: Work in our workshop, ensure the space is organised, safe and is working to enable our research.

* Strategic Improvements: Identify bottlenecks in deployment or lab workflows and develop strategies to improve efficiency, safety, and uptime.

* Global Alignment: Aligning with our other sites across the US, ensuring no misalignment of the technical data.

This is a full time on-site position.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Comfort operating in a technical environment, able to hold credible conversations with engineering leads about systems-level and architecture workflows.
* Skilled at running voice-of-customer processes and turning qualitative input into a structured plan.
* Ability to build structure and process without slowing teams down, tuned to an engineering audience.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication, able to align divisional and hub stakeholders without direct authority.

jobs.title: Intensive Care Coordinator – Youth & Family Mental Health
jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Outpatient and C-Change Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC)**

**Position Details**

* **Classification:** Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)
* **Location:** Oakland, CA / Hybrid (client services are provided in person; documentation can be completed remotely)
* **Schedule:** Full time, Monday–Friday
* **Pay:** $34.62 per hour

**Our Program: C-Change**

C-Change works with youth who are at risk of, or have been identified as, sexually exploited minors, helping them transform their lives. The program focuses on stabilization, reducing mental health symptoms, building self-efficacy and self-determination, creating community, and connecting youth to additional resources. Our specialized model includes mental health screening, advocacy, clinical case management, and psychotherapy for at-risk youth. We serve young people up to age 21 who live throughout the Bay Area.

**The Position**

The ICC will work mainly with youth and young adults in C-Change. The role was is also referred to as a Mental Health Care Coordinator.

You will be responsible for assessing clients and for developing, coordinating, carrying out, and overseeing intensive, community-based behavioral health care plans. Clients have moderate to high acuity and complex needs that may be behavioral, medical, developmental, and/or psychosocial.

Each youth is supported by a Child & Family Team (CFT) that you will assemble and lead. The team draws on family, natural supports such as friends, extended family, neighbors, and community members, and formal system partners such as child welfare, schools, and juvenile probation, all working together toward the youth's goals and toward lasting change. You will coordinate and facilitate regular CFT meetings and both monitor and contribute to the youth's progress.

Guided by the Integrated Core Practice Model, you will use clinical judgment and discretion, in partnership with the team, to evaluate strengths and needs, choose interventions, coordinate services across disciplines, manage crises, link clients to resources, build behavioral skills, and design individualized care strategies.

The work is varied. It involves interpreting clinical information, applying professional standards, and making clinically informed decisions. You'll provide services and attend agency meetings virtually (Zoom or phone), in the office, and in community settings such as our drop-in center, client homes, schools, and parks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Assessment and care plans:** Perform comprehensive biopsychosocial, behavioral health, risk, and functional assessments for clients with complex, high-acuity needs. Contribute to building, implementing, and tracking individualized care plans that use evidence-based and trauma-informed approaches. Assess clinical progress over time and change interventions as your ongoing assessment and professional judgment indicate.
* **CFT facilitation:** Set up, organize, and run CFT meetings regularly with youth, families, and their community partners. Facilitation training is provided.
* **Caseload and direct services:** Manage up to 19 clients, with 50% of your time (20 hours per week) spent providing behavioral health services to youth and families. This includes assessing strengths and needs, connecting youth to resources, supporting skill building, and providing crisis intervention and de-escalation, while producing high-quality documentation.
* **Crisis response:** Assess and respond to behavioral health crises, safety concerns, and urgent situations, both independently and alongside colleagues. Decide on appropriate interventions, escalation steps, mandated reporting, and emergency referrals using professional judgment.
* **Documentation and billing:** Write daily progress notes and complete other clinical documentation in line with WCC policies and procedures for EPSDT Medi-Cal and other billing requirements. You should know Medi-Cal reimbursement and billing procedures or be able to learn them.
* **Teamwork:** Collaborate with enthusiasm as a member of a multidisciplinary treatment team, helping youth and families set goals and move toward them.
* **Ethics and mission:** Meet all ethical and legal responsibilities, including those of a mandated reporter, and represent our mission and philosophy.

**What We're Looking For**

*Required:*

* At least 2 years of professional, direct work with children and/or families using a mental health framework, in behavioral health, care coordination, intensive case management, social services, healthcare coordination, or related clinical services.
* Demonstrated experience with adolescents/minors who have a dual diagnosis, high mental health needs, and/or have experienced child sexual exploitation (CSE).
* Experience and skill facilitating groups, trainings, or treatment teams.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Counseling, or a related field. Significant relevant professional experience in mental health or behavioral health services may be considered instead of a degree.
* A vehicle, current car insurance, and a clean California DMV record. Travel by car to meet clients is required, generally within 90 miles of the WCC office.

*Skills and qualities:*

* Strong crisis assessment and intervention skills, and sound professional judgment when situations are unclear or changing.
* Passion for working with foster youth, families, and young adults with complex trauma histories.
* Strong motivation to work within a team-based approach.

jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

We are dedicated to providing equitable and comprehensive treatment to individuals from all walks of life, ensuring everyone has access to the best possible recovery and health management solutions. Our clinic is committed to ongoing research and collaboration with healthcare professionals to continuously improve and innovate in our field. jobs.description:
**ABOUT VEG**

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

  

**THE JOB**

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer's experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
* Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
* Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say "yes" to customer needs
* Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
* Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience
* Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
* Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
* Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet's care and strengthen relationships
* Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

  

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
* Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
* Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
* The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos
* High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
* Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
* Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation
* Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
* Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs
* Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
* Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team's' accomplishments
* Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
* Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

  

**HOW WE INVEST IN YOU**

* Competitive compensation: Pay range is $20-$30 per hour, based on experience
* Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work
* Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people
* And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you're hungry

  

**DEI**

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is "Helping people and their pets when they need it most." And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world's veterinary emergency company.

**Hours:** 40 hours per week – Non – Exempt; 100% In person

**About Street Level Health Project:** Street Level Health Project (SLHP) is an Oakland-based nonprofit dedicated to improving the health, dignity, and well-being of underserved immigrant communities in the Bay Area. For more than two decades, Street Level has served as a trusted point of entry for workers and families facing barriers to healthcare, employment, legal services, and more. Our work is grounded in the belief that everyone deserves dignity, respect, and the opportunity to thrive regardless of immigration status or economic circumstance.

**About the Immigrant Defense (ID) Program:** The ID program works in coalition with partners like the Alameda County Immigration Legal and Education Partnership Rapid Response Network (ACILEP RNN), Adopt-A-Corner, and others to respond to the needs of the immigrant community. This is an agile, responsive program that works closely with the SLHP Day Labor Program and the Health & Well-Being Program. The program strives to build community within the movement and Bay Area ecosystem.

**Position Summary:** The ID Community Care Coordinator (CCC) helps families prepare in case of detention or deportation and supports families impacted by the detention or deportation of a community member. We have spent the last 2 years building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**  
  
We’re looking for an Test Operations Lead to join our Data team and own the operational side of testing the reliability of our hardware and firmware systems.  
  
This role is about piloting and then productionization of both unit and ongoing tests with a team of testers. You’ll work in coordination with Hardware, Firmware, and Data to define the framework and tools on which to build tests around. Your role is vital to ensuring that we get accurate test results in a timely manner and then turning those findings into action items.  
  
What You’ll Do

* Create documentation for testing
* Train testers
* Be in the weeds and test yourself anytime something new is being designed
* Create novel or improve pre-existing testing processes

What You’ll Bring

* Clear written and verbal communication to guide our testers
* Your ability to manage unexpected challenges
* Your ownership of key stakeholders with data operators, engineering, and support
* Excitement for the growth and development of robotics
* Someone adept at prioritization of competing requests, who’s able to move both quickly, and in an organized manner
* A level of hardcore-ness while still treating people like people
* Intermediate level understanding of hardware and firmware

Nice to Have

* Previous experience leading test and validation for technical systems
* Technical skills to build tools for testing
* Ability to leverage AI to help improve productivity

At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

Compensation Range: $180K - $220K

San Jose, California, United States

**Job Summary**

The Senior Onboarding Program Lead, Field Excellence owns the strategy, execution, continuous improvement and business impact of NetApp's sales new-hire onboarding program.

That means owning a journey that starts quickly after HR/IT onboarding, progresses through structured virtual learning and assessments, culminates in an application-focused onsite Capstone, and continues through role-based and post-onsite development toward a 6 month ramp objective.

**Lead Program Delivery, Governance & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Own major program experiences, including virtual onboarding and the onsite Capstone, ensuring consistent quality and execution.

**Drive Manager Accountability & New-Hire Readiness**

* Equip managers with the visibility, coaching tools and readiness frameworks needed to actively support ramp.
* Monitor learner progression and identify where intervention, additional coaching or program changes are needed.
* Ensure readiness decisions reflect demonstrated capability across the 30/60/90-day journey, not simply content completion.

**Measure Impact & Drive Program Evolution**

* Own program measurement across participation, completion, learner experience, readiness, manager engagement and time-to-productivity.

* Establish structured feedback loops and translate insights into a prioritized program roadmap.

**About Sprig**
===============

Sprig is the enterprise survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, companies have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers and markets. Those platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast businesses move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear insight. Research, insights, and customer experience teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the world's leading companies can act on evidence instead of assumptions.

Leading companies like Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, and Coinbase trust Sprig to conduct research at scale. Backed by $85M in funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're rapidly expanding our enterprise presence.

We’re redefining the category, with AI at the core. If you're excited to solve hard problems and have the chance to shape how the world's largest companies understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.

Working closely with Sales, Product, and other cross-functional teams, you'll build executive relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive strong customer retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In.
