jobs.title: Executive Assistant / Office Manager
jobs.description:
Velo3D is seeking a detail-oriented Executive Assistant and Office Manager to support our executive leadership team and run our Fremont office. This role manages executive calendars, travel and communications; prepares executive-level reports, presentations and meeting summaries; and tracks action items with leaders across engineering and operations.

This role combines the judgment and confidentiality of an Executive Assistant with the hands-on operational ownership of an Office Manager. You will be the first point of contact for visitors, customers and VIP guests, and you will keep office operations, vendors and budgets running on schedule.

### **Essential Functions**

Executive Support for the Executive Leadership Team

* Manage calendars, meeting coordination and day-to-day scheduling for multiple members of the executive leadership team, including cross-time-zone scheduling.
* Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, lodging, ground transportation and itineraries.
* Draft internal and external communications on behalf of executives.
* Prepare reports and presentations for executive leadership, board and customer audiences.
* Attend leadership and cross-functional meetings, record minutes, and convert them into executive summaries with decisions, action items, owners and due dates.
* Assign and track action items with directors and managers across engineering and operational functions, and report status to executives until closure.
* Coordinate the OKR and quarterly business review cadence for the leadership team, including scheduling, materials collection and progress tracking.
* Coordinate board meeting logistics and compile board materials.
* Prepare for upcoming executive commitments by assembling briefing materials, agendas and background documents in advance.
* Handle confidential executive, HR and financial information in accordance with company policy.
* Manage assigned projects from planning through completion, including timelines, owners and status reporting.

Office and Front Desk Operations

* Manage the front desk: greet visitors, manage incoming calls, mail and deliveries, and administer visitor check-in procedures.
* Coordinate customer and VIP visits, including site tours, meeting rooms, catering and hospitality.
* Manage office inventory, supplies, vendors and maintenance requests.
* Maintain an organized, safe and functional office environment for employees and guests.
* Partner with the Operations team and building/property management to resolve facilities issues.
* Track office operations spending against budget and report variances.

Employee Engagement

* Plan and execute company-wide events, team-building activities and celebrations, including vendor coordination and budget management.
* Support special projects related to internal communications, workplace programs and company-wide initiatives.

### **Basic Qualifications**

* Associate's degree, or high school diploma/GED plus 2 additional years of qualifying experience.
* 3+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner or Office Manager directly supporting VP-level or C-suite executives.
* Experience managing calendars for 2 or more executives at the same time, including recurring leadership meetings, cross-time-zone scheduling, and domestic and international travel.
* Experience preparing executive-level written materials, including meeting minutes, executive summaries, reports and presentations for leadership or board audiences.
* Experience recording meeting decisions and action items, assigning owners and due dates, and tracking items to closure with leaders across multiple functions.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365: Outlook (shared and delegate calendars), PowerPoint (building presentations from templates and data), Excel (formulas, sorting and filtering, pivot tables) and Word; working proficiency with Microsoft Teams or Zoom and Slack.
* 1+ year of experience managing front desk or office operations, including visitors, calls, mail and deliveries, vendors and supplies.
* Experience tracking an expense or operating budget against plan.
* Experience handling confidential executive, HR or financial information.
* Ability to work onsite in Fremont, CA, five days per week, with occasional travel (less than 5%).

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Executive Business Partner, including 5+ years supporting a CEO or C-suite team.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Management, Operations or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in a technology, engineering or advanced manufacturing company (e.g., additive manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, hardware), working with engineering and operations leaders.
* Experience at a growth-stage or late-stage company (Series C or later) or a public company.
* Experience supporting board meetings, including compiling board materials, coordinating logistics and recording minutes.
* Experience coordinating customer or executive visits, including site tours and VIP hospitality for external partners.
* Experience running an OKR or quarterly business review cadence for a leadership team.
* Experience planning company events or offsites for 50+ attendees, including vendor contracts and budget.
* Professional certification: Certified Administrative Professional (CAP), PMP or CAPM, or Microsoft Office Specialist (MOS) Expert.
* Proficiency with AI productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, meeting transcription tools) for drafting summaries and managing workflow.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Concur or Expensify, and travel booking platforms.

### **Education/ Certifications/ Clearances**

**Required:** Associate's degree, or high school diploma/GED plus 2 additional years of qualifying experience.

**Preferred:** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, Management, Operations or a related field.

jobs.title: Customer Support Associate
jobs.description:
**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerces brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

**The role**
------------

**Pay range: $68,000 – $102,000 USD per year** - Equity is included in every offer.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Specialist to become the face of customer support for Cuttable in Australia and the US, and help grow the function as we scale in Melbourne and San Francisco. This isn’t just about answering tickets. It’s about building a world-class support experience that delights customers, scales with us, and becomes a real competitive advantage.

You’ll be one of the first people in this role across Australia and the US, which means you’ll help set the standard for how we support Australian and American brands: handling incoming queries, solving problems fast, and building out the processes, tools and knowledge base that help our customers succeed at scale.

We want someone who’s customer-obsessed: the kind of person who leans in, gets curious, and is as excited about solving problems as our customers are about creating great ads. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a startup environment: hands-on, resourceful, and excited to have an impact from zero to one.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and work closely with our Customer Success Managers. This role is based in Melbourne (flexible hybrid, with in-person collaboration encouraged).

**What you’ll own**

* Being the first point of contact for all customer support queries via Intercom (and other channels as we grow), with a strong focus on fast turnaround: first response typically within 5 minutes, ongoing replies within 10 minutes, and every chat picked up within 3 minutes.
* Triaging, troubleshooting and resolving day-to-day platform, billing and account queries, balancing fast response with genuine care. Every ticket is a chance to build trust, not just close a queue.
* Support documentation, FAQs and video walkthroughs that let customers self-serve, keeping the knowledge base current as the product changes.
* Weekend and out-of-hours coverage on the support rota: responding to platform outages, system-wide failures and billing issues that block usage, and holding everything else for the next business day.

**What you’ll drive**

* A fast, high-quality support experience that reflects well on Cuttable, solving problems quickly without losing the personal touch.
* Clean escalation and handoffs: technical or product bugs go to Engineering and Product, pricing or expansion conversations go to the right Account Executive, and customers stay informed throughout. You’ll know the difference between a quick fix and the right fix.
* Support for Sales and Customer Success activities where customer context matters most, such as demo tenants, customer-ready assets and smooth handovers between teams.
* Definition and refinement of support processes, tools and playbooks to make the function more scalable as ticket volume grows, as one of the first people building it across Australia and the US.
* Tracking and reporting on key support metrics (response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction) so the team has real visibility into how support is performing.

**Who you’ll support**

* Product and Engineering, by capturing and sharing customer insights, recurring pain points and feature requests straight from the front line. You’ll read patterns in the queue, not just individual tickets.
* CSMs and Implementation Managers, with day-to-day platform, creative and general support queries, so they can stay focused on activation and account health.
* The wider GTM team, as an internal advocate for customers, always pushing for the best possible experience and flagging the right things to AEs, CSMs, Implementation Managers and Product without waiting to be asked.

### **Who we look for**

We hire for values as much as experience, because mindset carries you through the parts no job description can predict. Here’s what that looks like day to day at Cuttable:

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.
* **Create Customer Magic**: you listen hard enough to get to what customers actually need, not just what they said.
* **Say It (With Care)**: You say the honest thing, directly, and with genuine care for the person hearing it.
* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Experience in customer support, technical support, or a customer-facing SaaS role.
* A customer-obsessed approach: empathetic, patient, and able to make people feel heard and supported.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to learn new tools and workflows fast.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain things clearly, simply, and with a bit of personality.
* A proactive, resourceful streak. You don’t just solve the problem, you prevent it from happening again.

jobs.title: Support Counselor - ECM (Lead Care Manager)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**Lead Care Manager (ECM Support Counselor)**

Join our team as an ECM Support Counselor and take part in transforming the way Medi-Cal members with complex needs receive care and support.

As an ECM Support Counselor, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for Medi-Cal members enrolled in Enhanced Care Management (ECM). You will conduct outreach research across healthcare, community-based, and social-service settings throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to identify opportunities for connecting with and enrolling new client-members. You'll develop trusting relationships with members and provide comprehensive, individualized care management that addresses medical, behavioral health, and health-related social needs.

Working primarily in the community, you'll coordinate with health care providers, social service agencies, community organizations, and other members of the care team to ensure members receive the right services at the right time.

This is a full-time, benefited role with significant community-based work. The position requires flexibility to meet members where they live and receive services, including homes, health care settings, community centers, and other community locations. The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, has strong public speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with individuals or community groups, comfortable working in community-based settings, and culturally responsive and can support to individuals and families from diverse backgrounds.

  

**About Alternative Family Services**

Alternative Family Services is a Foster Family, Adoption and Mental Health Agency that has been serving abused and neglected children in our community since 1973. Our mission is to support vulnerable children and families in need of stability, safety, and well-being in communities. We provide a wide range of foster, adoption, mental health and transition-aged youth services in English and Spanish. We have eight locations throughout the Bay Area and over 200 employees. We celebrate diversity, equal opportunity, and excellence.

  

**Responsibilities and What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with community-based, social service, healthcare and other partner organizations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to increase awareness of ECM services and generate new client-member enrollment.
* Identify and engage with community-based, social-service or healthcare organizations to generate new client-member enrollment and strengthen community partnerships
* Plan, coordinate and participate in community outreach events to increase awareness and enrolment of ECM services, foster relationships with prospective clients, and generate new client-member enrollment
* Serve as the member’s primary point of contact, providing individualized and comprehensive care management; provide direct support services such as mentoring, skill-building, coaching, tutoring, and crisis response
* Develop person-centered care plans in partnership with members, their families or support systems, and the care team
* Meet with client-members in their homes and communities to assess needs, provide support, and help remove barriers to care
* Help client-members navigate health care and social service systems and connect them to appropriate providers and community resources across multiple systems
* Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure client-members successfully access recommended services
* Maintain regular communication with health plans, providers, community-based organizations, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team
* Advocate for members and help ensure their preferences, goals and needs remain central to their care
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in accordance with organizational, Medi-Cal, and health plan requirements
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy standards
* Monitor member progress and update care plans as needs and circumstances change
* Participate in care team meetings, case consultations, and other activities designed to improve coordination and outcomes
* Respond appropriately to urgent member needs and help connect members to crisis or emergency resources when necessary

  

**Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain fingerprint and government and Agency required background clearances
* CPR/First Aid certification
* Valid California driver’s license with an acceptable driving record, auto insurance showing as an insured driver on the policy and vehicle registration

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing's fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

**About the Role:**

Our People Team is a small, nimble force with outsized impact across the organization. As Wing scales, we serve as a strategic partner for the business—helping build the culture, talent layer, organizational design and dynamic environment where exceptional talent can thrive, innovate, and propel our next chapter of growth.

jobs.description:
**GENERAL SUMMARY**

The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited to develop new skills while building a foundation for future advancement. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

  

**Our Culture**

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our "Code of Culture".

Our Code of Culture includes Our Mantra, Our Actions We Live By, and Pete's Promise:

**Our Mantra:**

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Our Actions We Live By:**

**Actions We Live By**. It's who we are when we step into our full power.

**Keep It Real. Always.** We need open and honest discussions. We need courage to speak up and to call things out that aren't good enough. And we navigate tough conversations with empathy and grace.

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner**. Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

**Stay Humble. Hustle Harder.** Show up and do the hard work. Be a gritty, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of crew. Know it's never about one person-we are a part of a powerful team.

**One Team. One Voice.** Be ONE united team. When we move in the same direction, there are no limits to what we can accomplish.

**Be Curious. Ask Why**. Stay member curious. We seek to understand, and we never settle. We ask questions to truly understand the core of a matter.

**Pete's Promise:**

Service Forward

Ruthlessly Consistent

Do the Right Thing

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

### **PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS**

### **Club Cleanliness & Housekeeping**

* Maintain cleanliness and appearance standards throughout assigned Club areas, including fitness spaces, locker rooms, lobby, reception desks, pool areas, restrooms, and common areas.
* Perform detail cleaning and preventive maintenance activities.
* Restock supplies, amenities, janitorial products, and inventory items.
* Assist with laundry operations, including collecting, washing, drying, and folding towels.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
* Identify and communicate maintenance and cleanliness issues requiring further attention.

### **Customer Service & Member Experience**

* Greet members and guests upon arrival and throughout the Club.
* Check members and guests into the Club and applicable activity areas.
* Ensure guest registration requirements and applicable fees are completed.
* Book appointments, programs, services, and class reservations.
* Provide information regarding Club amenities, programming, events, and services.
* Deliver exceptional service experiences to members, guests, and fellow Associates.
* Build positive relationships with members and guests through proactive engagement and responsiveness.
* Represent the Club professionally through image, communication, follow-through, and responsiveness.
* Assist in generating membership and program leads by identifying prospective member interest.

### **Reception & Operational Support**

* Answer and transfer incoming phone calls.
* Assist with property tours and membership sales as needed.
* Operate point-of-sale systems and cash registers.
* Process payments and member account charges.
* Complete opening and closing duties for assigned operational areas.
* Support Club events, programs, and special activities.
* Assist in operational coverage across departments as business needs require.

### **Fitness Operations**

* Provide general supervision of fitness and recovery areas.
* Ensure fitness and recovery spaces are clean, safe, organized, and operating according to Club policies and procedures.
* When appropriate, instruct members on the proper and safe use of fitness equipment.
* Monitor fitness floor conditions and report equipment issues or safety concerns.
* Ensure equipment, accessories, and recovery amenities are properly organized and maintained.
* Monitor music, televisions, and overall environmental conditions within fitness areas.
* Maintain exceptional member service standards within fitness facilities.
* Support fitness programs, events, and departmental initiatives as assigned.

### **Pool Deck & Hospitality Support (If Applicable)**

* Welcome members and guests to the pool and recreation areas.
* Assist with seating, amenities, and event support.
* Maintain refreshment stations and towel operations.
* Assist with setup, breakdown, and cleanliness of designated areas.

### **Communication & Teamwork**

* Communicate timely and effectively with managers, team members, and members.
* Follow up on assigned tasks and member requests.
* Participate actively in required meetings, events, trainings, and development opportunities.
* Collaborate across departments to ensure operational excellence and a seamless member experience.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

### **Other Job Functions**

* Work a flexible schedule that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Provide support across multiple departments based on Club operational needs and business demands.

jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **AI Enablement & Learning and Development Partner**

Astranis is a fast-growing company where hardware, software, and operations teams ship on a tight schedule. The tools to work faster, especially AI tools, are already here. What we need now is someone to help every team use them well.

As our AI Enablement & Learning and Development Lead, you will own how Astranis learns. For your first three quarters, your focus is AI enablement: getting real, measurable adoption of the tools we already have. From there, you will broaden into a full learning and development function, including team-level onboarding, on-demand skills training, and a manager academy. You will be a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and runs programs yourself, with room to grow the function and, over time, scale into a leadership role.

You will report to the Director of Employee Success and sit on our AI Steering Committee.

#### **Role**

Execute on our AI Enablement Strategy (this is the focus for the first three quarters)

* 4 Pillars to this strategy:
* + Turn our existing AI training content (101 through 103) into a polished, formal curriculum with clear learning paths for different roles and skill levels.
  + Design and launch an AI for Managers course that gets team leads using these tools themselves and coaching their teams to do the same.
  + Coordinate company-wide hackathons twice a year, owning logistics, communications, judging, and follow-through so winning ideas turn into real workflow improvements.
  + Elevate our superuser community. Our best AI practitioners are already spread across the company and active in Slack; your job is to showcase their work through lunch and learns, workshops, and internal spotlights, and to make it easy for others to learn from them.
* Monitor key metrics like weekly average logins by team to evaluate progress and identify hotspots.
* Provide feedback to the AI Steering Committee, bringing usage data and employee feedback to inform decisions on tools and policy.

Formalize our learning and development function

* Partner with team leads to identify skill gaps and design team-level onboarding that gets new hires productive faster.
* Create targeted training on demand where teams need more support. (For example, a proposal writing workshop for teams responding to customer RFPs.)
* Build and launch a leadership academy program scoped for director-level leaders.
* Establish simple, repeatable ways to measure whether training works, and use what you learn to improve every program.
* Create lightweight systems, templates, and a knowledge base so learning scales beyond live sessions.
* Develop a framework to assess the feasibility and business case for an engineering rotational program, define program requirements and structure, and lead the design, development, and implementation of the program if approved.

#### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in learning and development, enablement, change management, or internal training, ideally at a fast-growing technology or engineering company.
* A track record of running adoption or enablement programs end to end and being able to show the results with data.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools. You use them regularly and can teach others to use them well, from complete beginners to power users.
* Strong instructional design and facilitation skills, in live workshops and in self-serve formats.
* Experience building or running internal communities, events, or hackathons.
* Comfort earning trust with highly technical employees and managers who are very busy.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to work independently, prioritize across many requests, and move quickly with limited process.

#### **Bonus**

* Experience launching a manager or leadership development program.
* Background supporting engineering, aerospace, or other deeply technical teams.
* Familiarity with learning platforms or LMS tools, and with analytics for tracking usage and engagement.
* Experience partnering with executives or a steering committee on technology rollouts.

jobs.description:
### **In Some Jobs You Take Orders. In This One, You Write History.**

Join the healthcare information technology team that’s turning drug and medical device data into knowledge used by thousands of hospitals, the majority of U.S. health plans, retail pharmacies and pharmacy benefit managers, and millions of health care decision-makers throughout the world. Partnering with our information system developer and healthcare institution customers, you’ll help evolve leading-edge thinking into reality and make a measurable difference in improving human health.

We’re looking for people who are intelligent, productive, committed, willing and able to go above and beyond, passionate about making a difference, innovative and energized. You’ll play an essential role in a successful company’s continued growth.

**Are you ready for this exciting challenge?**

**First Databank (FDB)** is currently seeking a **Customer Support Lead** to join the **Customer Solutions team** . The Customer Support Lead plays a critical role in helping customers get timely answers, resolve issues, and make effective use of the solutions they rely on. FDB serves organizations across healthcare, including EHR vendors, pharmacies, hospitals, and pharmacy benefit managers.

The Lead handles customer inquiries and technical support through phone and email, takes ownership of cases through resolution, and coordinates with internal teams when additional expertise is needed. The Lead also supports the day-to-day effectiveness of the Customer Support team by helping colleagues resolve complex cases, monitoring queue health and service levels, conducting case quality reviews, and identifying opportunities to improve processes, documentation, and the customer experience. This is a hands-on lead role that provides subject matter guidance and peer coaching and serves as an escalation point.

This position is based out of our Carmel, IN or South San Francisco, CA office and follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to work on-site at least three days per week.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide front-line customer support by phone and email, including technical support, feature and functionality guidance, and application troubleshooting.
* Own customer cases from intake through resolution, keeping customers informed about status, next steps, and expected follow-up.
* Troubleshoot complex or recurring issues and coordinate with internal teams to reach timely resolutions.
* Serve as a day-to-day resource for Customer Support colleagues on case handling, troubleshooting, processing questions, and FDB products.
* Provide peer coaching and feedback and help identify team training needs and opportunities to strengthen product and process knowledge.
* Monitor the support queue and relevant service measures, identify emerging risks, and help ensure cases receive appropriate and timely attention.
* Identify patterns in customer inquiries, issues, and feedback, and raise recurring or high-impact concerns to management and the appropriate internal teams.
* Help develop, maintain, and improve support processes, knowledge resources, and customer-facing documentation.
* Represent Customer Support in cross-functional initiatives and share customer insights that can inform product, process, and service improvements.
* Take on special projects and other customer support responsibilities as assigned.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Strong customer service, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly to both clinical and non-clinical audiences.
* Sound judgment, empathy, and professionalism when handling customer concerns and escalations.
* Strong organization and time-management skills, including the ability to prioritize competing work and follow through independently.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Proficiency with approved AI-enabled tools for research, case summarization, and drafting, with the judgment to verify outputs and follow company policies for customer and confidential information.

**Required Experience**
-----------------------

* Five or more years of experience in customer service, technical support, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience working with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
* Familiarity with supporting customers who use APIs, including helping troubleshoot integration or data exchange questions.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or hospital environments, or familiarity with related workflows.
* Experience supporting software, healthcare data, or other technical products.
* Familiarity with case management or customer support systems and basic database concepts.
* Experience coaching peers, reviewing case quality, monitoring service measures, or improving support processes.

**Accommodations**
------------------

We are committed to an accessible application process. If you need an accommodation to apply, please contact accommodations@fdbhealth.com . This email address is for accommodation requests only.

**Benefits**
------------

This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance; a 401(k) retirement plan; a flexible spending account; paid holidays; paid time off; an employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

**Compensation**  
  
The base salary range below is the Company's good-faith estimate for this position in the posted work location at the time of posting. Final starting salary will be based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, training, certifications, education, location and market considerations.

Base Salary Range:

$53,000 — $86,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate, Velocity
jobs.description:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize sales performance. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, and now we're expanding our platform to solve broader sales planning challenges. Recognized by industry analysts like Forrester and G2 and backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia, ICONIQ, Accel, and Sapphire Ventures, we empower high-growth companies like Netflix, Figma, and Stripe with the flexibility and insights needed to drive revenue performance.

Join a talented, fast-growing team committed to solving some of the most complex and impactful problems in sales performance management.

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Customer Success Associate (CSA) to join our Velocity team – where CaptivateIQ delivers customer outcomes and value at scale. You’ll help a base of 300+ customers get measurably more value from CaptivateIQ by spotting what’s happening in their accounts early, and guiding them to the right resources, recommendations, and advice at the right moment – before a quiet account turns into a renewal risk.

This is not a named book-of-business or renewals role. Your focus is derisking accounts, detecting signals, and driving customer outcomes. The best Velocity CSAs are value detectives who are laser focused on execution at scale. You’ll use data signals and efficient, high-quality customer conversations to understand which outcomes each customer cares about, segment customers accordingly, and run programs for each segment that move them along their “Golden Path” – the recommended journey to recognizing value with CaptivateIQ. You’ll do it through a mix of 1:many communications (in-app, email, Slack, webinars), group office hours, and targeted live calls where a human conversation makes the difference.

You’ll work from a prioritized queue of tasks and plays in our customer success platform (ChurnZero), driven by what the data tells us to do next. You’ll also work to automate and improve the reactive work that exists today, so that more of your time goes to proactive outreach and campaign development. Velocity is evolving quickly, and you’ll execute plays consistently while giving feedback that helps us improve them as the segment strategy evolves.

If you’re curious, organized, comfortable with high-volume work, and energized by the idea of building scaled programs that make a measurable difference to customers, this role is for you.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Be a value detective: Use data signals (product usage, seat utilization, admin activity, health score, sentiment, support and survey responses) and efficient insight collection to understand each customer’s goals, identify gaps in value, and properly segment the Velocity portfolio.
* Execute methodically around signals: Prioritize your day around tasks and plays in ChurnZero that signals trigger, and quickly execute the associated actions based on what the data tells you.
* Capture outcomes and sentiment: Validate customer-stated outcomes and keep account data, sentiment, contacts, and risk records accurate so that programs, risk reviews, and teammates can rely on them.
* Identify and mitigate risk early: Derisking accounts is the core of this role. Detect risk through early signals, document it in risk records, and run mitigation plays well ahead of renewal, working with the Renewals Manager on accounts approaching the renewal stage. Give feedback that helps evolve the automated plays that catch risk sooner.
* Run programs by segment: Execute plays and campaigns for each customer segment and outcome that drive increasing value from CaptivateIQ over time, with consistent, high-quality follow-through.
* Drive adoption along the Golden Path: Guide customers to the features, configurations, and best practices that map to their stated outcome in our Value Framework, partnering closely with our Value Engineer and Education teams.
* Scale through multi-channel communication: Create and deploy 1:many programmatic communications – in-app messages, email, Slack, webinars, and cohort-based adoption campaigns – that connect customers to the right resources at the right time.
* Connect live where it counts: Host group office hours and run targeted live outreach to customers who need a human conversation, such as new admins, low-adoption accounts, and customers working toward a new outcome.
* Manage the inbound queue efficiently: Work customer questions and requests through a queue-based, round-robin model with consistent quality and response times, and flag the patterns that should be automated or self-served back to Product, Education and Support.
* Support renewals and upsells: Partner with the Velocity Renewals Manager and Customer Success Manager, who own renewals. Provide the risk, outcome, and adoption context they need, and help identify seat and service expansion opportunities by connecting customers to the next best step for their business.
* Help shape the playbook: Give feedback on which signals, plays, and messages work and which are noisy. Spot patterns across accounts and turn them into improvements to the Velocity segment strategy. Stay aware of the competitive landscape and flag competitor threats you see in customer conversations.
* Use AI to scale your impact: Integrate AI tools and agents into your daily workflow, from account research and analysis to drafting outreach and automating routine tasks.
* Be the voice of the customer: Partner with Product, Support, Professional Services, and Education to surface Velocity customer feedback and trends.

### **What You'll Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing or prospect-facing role, ideally one with high-volume outreach and clear structure, such as Scaled Customer Success, Business Development, Support, or SMB Account Management.
* Comfort working from a shared queue and a round-robin approach to inbound customer communication, with consistent quality and responsiveness.

jobs.description:
#### **Job Title: Project Manager, Whole Person Health**

Location: Bethesda, Maryland (Remote)

Reports To: Director, Whole Person Health

FLSA Status: Exempt

Must be able to provide proof of residence in one of these states: KS, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, TN, TX, PA, VA, WA, WV, or DC

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Position Summary:**

The Project Manager, Whole Person Health is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of projects and initiatives in the Whole Person Health portfolio. This role will focus on the continuous improvement of NACHC's PRAPARE ® (Protocol for Responding to and Assessing Patients' Assets, Risks, and Experiences) portfolio.

This role requires strong project management and organizational skills in addition to working knowledge of whole-person screening assessments and healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, HL7® FHIR®, Gravity Project).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

1. Project and Portfolio Management

* Lead the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of assigned projects and strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate activities across crossfunctional teams, partners, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Monitor progress toward project goals, deliverables, and performance measures.
* Develop reports, presentations, and communications for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Conduct project reviews, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, contractual requirements, and operational expectations, as applicable.
* Support development and implementation of sustainable processes, resources, and tools that advance organizational priorities.

2. Health Center Engagement and Technical Assistance

* Provide technical assistance to health centers, PCAs, and HCCNs implementing PRAPARE® and social needs screening workflows.
* Support health center efforts to integrate PRAPARE® into electronic health records and care coordination processes.
* Facilitate peer learning opportunities focused on PRAPARE® implementation challenges and best practices.
* Respond to PRAPARE ®inquiries and provide ongoing support and resources to participating organizations.

3. Training, Education, and Learning Collaboratives

* Design and manage national learning collaboratives, webinars, workshops, and conference sessions related to PRAPARE® implementation.
* Develop educational materials, toolkits, implementation guides, and training curricula.
* Coordinate faculty, subject matter experts, and advisory groups supporting PRAPARE® initiatives.
* Facilitate virtual and inperson meetings focused on social needs screening and intervention strategies.
* Promote dissemination of promising practices and innovative health center models.

4. Data, Evaluation, and Quality Improvement

* Support collection, analysis, and interpretation of PRAPARE®related data and related interoperability standards. (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project)
* Support the development dashboards, reports, briefs, presentations, and infographics that communicate findings and impact.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen use of PRAPARE® data for population health management, quality improvement, and health equity initiatives.
* Support efforts related to data standardization, interoperability, and reporting requirements.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Development

* Build and maintain relationships with health centers, PCAs, HCCNs, federal agencies, health information technology partners, communitybased organizations, and national stakeholders.
* Represent NACHC at conferences, meetings, workgroups, and national forums.
* Support development of strategic partnerships that advance PRAPARE® adoption and sustainability.
* Engage external stakeholders in collaborative efforts to address whole person health and community wellbeing.

6. PRAPARE® Licensing and Stewardship

* Manage the administration and oversight of PRAPARE® licensing agreements, including onboarding, renewals, and stakeholder communications.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for organizations seeking to adopt, implement, or expand use of PRAPARE®.
* Maintain accurate licensing records, documentation, and tracking systems to support program operations and reporting.
* Coordinate licensing processes and ensure compliance with PRAPARE® usage requirements and organizational policies.
* Build and maintain relationships with licensed organizations and partners to support adoption, sustainability, and effective use of PRAPARE®.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Master's degree preferred in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Social Work, Public Policy, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be substituted for advanced education.
* Working knowledge of PRAPARE® and its application in community health center settings.
* Experience implementing or supporting PRAPARE within clinical, community health, or population health settings.
* Experience supporting implementation of screening, referral, care coordination, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Experience supporting wholeperson health screening, assessment, referral, and community resource connection programs
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project), and related interoperability standards.
* Experience working with electronic health records (EHRs), health information exchange, interoperability initiatives, or social needs data collection and reporting efforts.
* 10% travel to NACHC conferences and events.

jobs.description:
*Remote (U.S.-Based) | Optional hybrid in the Bay Area*  
*Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care*  
*Job Type: Full-time W2*

**Overview**

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife — and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need better visibility into how work moves through our inboxes, how our teams perform, and how to deploy our workforce efficiently.

We're looking for a **Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning** to build and own the analytical and workforce planning capabilities that power our Async Operations organization.

This person will design and establish the metrics, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that help us understand demand, throughput, productivity, service levels, and cost. You'll turn complex operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make better decisions every day.

You'll work closely with Async Operations leaders to identify what's driving SLA performance, where work is getting stuck, how much capacity we need, and where we can improve productivity or eliminate unnecessary work. You'll independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and influence decisions about staffing, workflows, and technology investments.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, and comfortable independently exploring complex datasets. They're excited to use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, build models, and solve operational problems. They can translate data into clear recommendations that help leaders make better staffing, workflow, and operational decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building analytical capabilities from the ground up and using data to drive operational change.

**The goal:** Deliver an excellent patient experience while continuously improving throughput, workforce efficiency, and cost per visit.

You won't just report on how the inbox is performing - you'll help us figure out how to make it perform better.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Analytics & Performance**

* Design and own the analytics and reporting framework for Async Operations, providing visibility into volume, throughput, turnaround times, backlogs, productivity, and SLAs.
* Build dashboards, reporting, and recurring analyses that help leaders understand operational performance and take action.
* Establish consistent definitions and measurement frameworks for key inbox metrics across teams and workflows.
* Analyze how work moves through the inbox, including incoming volume, completed work, aging, handoffs, and bottlenecks.
* Independently lead complex analyses to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities, including in areas where existing data or measurement frameworks are incomplete.
* Partner with Operations leaders to translate insights into measurable process and performance improvements.

**SLA & Throughput Management**

* Develop and own the analytical approach to understanding, monitoring, and improving SLA performance across inbox workflows.
* Identify whether SLA misses are driven by demand, staffing, productivity, routing, workflow design, or technology.
* Analyze throughput and backlog trends to identify where work is accumulating and what interventions will have the greatest impact.
* Develop leading indicators that help teams proactively identify service-level risks before they become problems.
* Measure the impact of operational changes on response times, throughput, quality, and patient experience.
* Recommend and help prioritize operational interventions based on expected impact, feasibility, and resource requirements.

**Workforce Planning & Capacity Management**

* Design and establish workforce forecasting and capacity planning models that translate expected work volumes into staffing requirements by team, workflow, skill, and time period.
* Own the development of annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly workforce plans, with visibility into daily capacity needs.
* Account for productivity, scheduling, PTO, training, shrinkage, and other factors that affect available capacity.
* Analyze workforce utilization and productivity to identify opportunities to improve resource allocation.
* Advise Operations leadership on staffing requirements, workforce allocation, cross-training, and capacity shifts to protect SLAs while optimizing cost.
* Lead capacity scenario planning for seasonal demand, holiday coverage, growth, and changes in operational workflows.

**Productivity & Cost Optimization**

* Develop and own the measurement frameworks for productivity, cost per completed action, and async cost per visit.
* Identify opportunities to increase throughput, reduce unnecessary work, and improve workforce efficiency.
* Analyze variation in productivity across teams, workflows, and work types to understand improvement opportunities.
* Quantify the capacity and financial impact of workflow improvements, staffing changes, and technology investments.
* Partner with Operations and Product to measure the impact of automation, AI, routing improvements, and process redesign.
* Advise Operations leadership on opportunities to reduce cost, improve workforce efficiency, and prioritize operational and technology investments without compromising service levels or quality.

**What you will need to succeed**

* 7+ years of experience in Operations Analytics, Workforce Planning, Business Operations, Data Analytics, or a related analytical role, including demonstrated ownership of complex analytical or workforce planning initiatives.
* Strong data fluency and ability to independently explore complex datasets, understand data structures and relationships, validate analytical outputs, and draw reliable conclusions.
* AI-first approach to analytics, with demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate data exploration, analysis, modeling, reporting, and problem-solving.

----------------------------

As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. ------------------

* Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.
* Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.
* Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.

* Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.
* Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.
* Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.
* Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.
* Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.

* Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.
* Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.
* Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.

Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.

Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. Coalfire is on a mission to make the world a safer place by solving our clients’ hardest cybersecurity challenges. We work at the cutting edge of technology to advise, assess, automate, and ultimately help companies navigate the ever-changing cybersecurity landscape. We are headquartered in Chicago, Illinois with offices across the U.S. and U.K., and we support clients around the world.

But that’s not who we are – that’s just what we do.

We are thought leaders, consultants, and cybersecurity experts, but above all else, we are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are hungry to learn, grow, and make a difference.

### **Position Summary**

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will be responsible for end-to-end project life cycle management. This role will work directly with the DivisionHex teams to support the multiple frameworks and teams across Coalfire to successfully deliver projects within the defined scope, on time, and on budget. The Senior Project Manager works with all stakeholders in building and growing client relationships and handling escalated issues appropriately. The Senior Project Manager is expected to work independently with little supervision over their daily activities.

### **What You'll Do**

* Full project life cycle ownership: successful project delivery will include full implementation from initiation to deployment for multiple initiatives simultaneously
* Serves as the main point of contact for the customer and the Coalfire team throughout the project
* Prepare project plans for all phases of the project or program with appropriate level of detail
* Work with Resource Deployment Managers to secure resources to achieve project objectives in planned timeframe
* Demonstrates ability to manage a high-volume portfolio while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and moving work forward efficiently
* Skilled at keeping pace with large accounts involving multiple moving parts
* Closely work with engagement lead to manage the day-to-day activities and resources on project engagements
* Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverable, dependencies, risks and issues, communicating across leadership
* Understand interdependencies between technology, operations, and business needs
* Responsible for project scope, budget, timelines, communication, and change management
* Set and continually manage project expectations and risks while delegating and managing deliverable with project team members and stakeholders
* Monitor, track and control issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables. Escalates issues when necessary and follows escalation through to resolution
* Develop and deliver progress reports, requirements documentation and presentations to various audiences, including project team, sponsors, and key stakeholders
* Work with a team of matrixed employees to deliver a succinct customer experience
* Ensure that projects and programs are proceeding according to established quality standards
* Understand project management principles, methods, and techniques
* Effectively applies Coalfire methodology and enforces project standards. Provides feedback on process changes and improvements
* Perform other duties as assigned
* Maintains company defined billable utilization targets

### **What You'll Bring**

* Minimum of 5 years of project management experience
* Minimum of 3 years experience working in a client facing, consulting environment
* Minimum of 3 years experience managing cybersecurity and/or penetration testing engagements
* Bachelor's Degree or associate degree plus equivalent experience in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field of study.
* Ability to provide full time support DivisionHex teams globally
* Experience with Smartsheets or Microsoft Project
* Able to structure and lead cross-functional teams and stakeholders through the full life cycle of projects
* Demonstrated understanding of Project Management methodology: including waterfall and agile methodologies
* Proven success managing several projects simultaneously
* Experience creating, adapting, or updating project management governance and processes for a centralized PMO
* Demonstrated project ownership and consistent delivery on commitments.
* Excellent communication skills including, presenting, editing, and writing with C-level executives.
* Entrepreneurial skills with experience implementing new projects and concepts within organizations, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent customer service skills
* Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills
* Ability to self-manage in a fast paced and dynamic environment
* Leadership skills, the ability to own project success, and proven consistency on meeting deliverables and commitments

### **Bonus Points**

* PMP, CSM, PgMP, or related project management certification

*The salary range listed is a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role based on national salary averages. The actual salary offer to the successful candidate will be based on job-related education, geographic location, training, licensure and certifications and other factors. You may also be eligible to participate in annual incentive, commission, and/or recognition programs.*

**Senior Program Managers - Investment Management & Technology Transformation**

**Location:** Remote - US and Canada  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time or Contract Opportunities  
**Industry:** Investment and Asset Management

***Please note:*** *This posting represents a* ***pipeline*** *for upcoming consulting projects in the US and Canada regions. We’re always excited to meet strong candidates and will reach out when a relevant opportunity becomes available.*

**About Cutter:**

At Cutter Associates, we empower the world’s leading asset managers and asset owners with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. For nearly 30 years, and with a global presence, we’ve combined expert consulting with proprietary research and industry benchmarking to help top-tier investment firms make smarter, faster decisions. Our global team is known for its deep domain expertise, collaborative spirit, and relentless curiosity. As we expand into new markets and capabilities, now is the perfect time to grow your career with a company that values insight, innovation, and impact.

**Why Cutter:**

At Cutter Associates, we believe people do their best work when they’re trusted, supported, and empowered to thrive - wherever they are.

* **Established credibility, entrepreneurial spirit** – Founded in 1998 and backed by Nomura Research Institute (NRI), we blend the stability of a global research and technology powerhouse with the agility of a small, fast-moving firm.
* **Global reach** - We partner with leading investment firms across North America, EMEA, and APAC, giving you meaningful exposure and exciting challenges.
* **Fully remote, fully connected** - We’re a remote-first company with a flexible work model and a deeply collaborative culture.
* **Growth-focused** - From client exposure and internal knowledge groups to tailored learning paths, we invest in your development from day one.
* **Performance-driven, people-first** - We offer competitive pay, bonuses, profit sharing, and benefits that support your whole self.
* **A culture that values people** - We take pride in our thoughtful, collaborative, and inclusive environment. We’re a team of individuals who care deeply - about our work, our clients, and each other.

Whether you’re launching your consulting career or bringing decades of experience, Cutter is a place where you can thrive.

**Position Overview**

Cutter Associates is building a pipeline of experienced **Senior Program Managers** to support complex business and technology transformation initiatives across the investment management industry.

We are looking for seasoned delivery professionals with strong investment management domain expertise and a proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional programs. These initiatives may include investment platform implementations, enterprise data modernization, operating model transformation, investment operations improvements, and broader technology transformation programs.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of strategic thinking, hands-on program delivery, executive stakeholder management, and the ability to drive accountability across multiple workstreams, teams, and vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional business and technology transformation programs within investment management.
* Develop and manage integrated program plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocations, milestones, and dependencies.
* Establish program governance structures, reporting frameworks, risk management processes, and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including business stakeholders, technology teams, project managers, business analysts, and external vendors.
* Partner with senior leadership and executive sponsors to align program objectives with business priorities.
* Facilitate Steering Committee meetings and provide executive-level reporting on program progress, financials, risks, issues, and key decisions.
* Proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, resolve escalated issues, and manage dependencies across interconnected workstreams.
* Support organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, and adoption of new technologies and operating models.
* Track program outcomes, benefits realization, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Drive accountability across internal teams and third-party service providers to ensure successful delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Extensive experience in program or project management, preferably within investment management, asset management, or financial services.
* Proven experience managing large-scale, multimillion-dollar business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of investment management operations, processes, and technology platforms.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and coordinating delivery across multiple workstreams and vendors.
* Demonstrated success managing program budgets, schedules, resource plans, risks, and dependencies.
* Experience engaging executive leadership, Steering Committees, and senior business stakeholders.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Proficiency with project management and reporting tools such as Jira, MS Project, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering investment technology implementations, including OMS/EMS, IBOR/ABOR, investment accounting, performance, risk, or enterprise data management platforms.
* Experience with investment data architecture, data governance, cloud migration, or enterprise data transformation.
* Knowledge of front-, middle-, and back-office investment operations across public and/or private markets.
* Experience working with institutional asset managers, pension funds, investment consultants, or financial technology providers.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Comfrt**

Comfrt is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer brands, dedicated to blending mental wellness, inclusivity, and elevated comfort into every piece we create. Our mission goes beyond clothing — we strive to build a community where everyone feels supported and seen. As we continue to grow, we're seeking a creative and motivated Graphic Designer to join our team and shape how Comfrt shows up visually across every brand touchpoint.  
  
**About the Role**

The Senior Creative Project Manager is responsible for managing projects from brief intake through creative production, review, and delivery, keeping timelines, teams, and stakeholders aligned along the way. This role sits at the center of creative execution, partnering with cross-functional teams, the eComm Studio, Photo Production, and the internal creative team to deliver work on time and on brief. The Senior Project Manager will also work with the SVP of Creative Operations and Director of Creative Operations to develop, implement, and refine the processes and tools that make the work run smoothly.

**What You'll Do:**

**Project Management:**

* Manage multiple, cross-channel creative projects simultaneously from kickoff through final delivery, owning scope, schedule, and resource management.
* Translate creative briefs into actionable project plans, with clear deliverables, milestones, and owners.
* Run kickoff meetings, status check-ins, and review sessions, and keep action items and decisions documented.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for creative projects, keeping internal stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and changes.
* Manage review and approval cycles, consolidating feedback and driving decisions to avoid unnecessary revision rounds.
* Escalate roadblocks and resourcing conflicts to leadership, with recommendations for solutions and alternate approaches.

**Reporting and Process Management:**

* Document project workflows and share reports, status documents, and key learnings across teams.
* Provide feedback on project management tools and help onboard new team members to standard practices.
* Track and help improve the creative intake, review, and approval processes.
* Track project metrics such as on-time delivery, revision counts, and turnaround time, and flag patterns that suggest process improvements.
* Partner with the Director of Creative Operations to identify and propose improvements to creative workflows.

**Who You Are:**

* 5+ years creative project management or production management experience at a brand or agency including working on cross-channel creative projects.
* Expert knowledge of creative production processes, including briefing, timeline management, reviews, and delivery.
* Strong organizational skills, with a track record of managing competing priorities and tight deadlines.
* Hands-on experience managing projects through tools such as Asana, Monday, Wrike or similar, along with a digital asset management system.
* Clear, concise communication, with the ability to lead meetings and align diverse stakeholders.
* Experience working with both creative teams and business partners, and a collaborative approach to feedback and decision-making.
* A solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, facing unanticipated shifts or changes with an even keeled and flexible mindset.
* PMP, Agile, or similar project management certification is a plus.

**Our Investment in You:**

* Be part of a purpose-driven company that's shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
* Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
* Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
* Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

*The salary range for this role is $110k-$140k. Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.*

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About By the Pixel**

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

We support our clients end-to-end: strategy, design, custom development, hosting, tiered production support, SEO, paid advertising, and content marketing. Most of what we build is engineered from scratch, because a one-size-fits-all bundle rarely fits.

**How this role fits**

The Project Manager runs projects from scoping through delivery and manages ongoing retainer and support work, coordinating the internal team and keeping work on schedule and within its approved budget. You'll work closely with the Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and anything commercial, and with the Project Strategist, who owns what gets built and why on projects that have one.

**What you'll own**

**Project Planning & Scoping**

* Leads scoping and estimating for proposed and upcoming work, defining scope and deliverables with the project department leads and other subject matter experts on the team, and working from the goals and requirements the Project Strategist sets where one is assigned.
* Works with the Account Manager throughout scoping so estimates reflect the client's budget and commercial constraints.
* Updates estimates with department leads as requirements change during the project.
* Creates and maintains the project schedule, timeline, and plan, incorporating the client-side deadlines and contractual commitments the Account Manager supplies.
* Looks for ways to simplify how work is sequenced and structured, reducing the handoffs and dependencies that slow a project down.
* Decides when a project is better served by sprints than by a timeline-based structure, and runs them accordingly.

**Driving Progress**

* Plans and leads project kickoff meetings, ensuring the client and internal team are aligned on goals, roles, expectations, and next steps before work begins.
* Follows up on unclear requirements, pending decisions, and unresolved dependencies to prevent work from stalling, and brings in the Project Strategist for requirements questions when one is assigned.
* Tracks what the client and third-party vendors owe the project, such as content, assets, access, and approvals, and follows up when any of it is late.
* Identifies risks and blockers with the project team early, resolves them, and escalates any it cannot resolve to the Account Manager as soon as they arise.
* Monitors project progress daily and keeps the project team and Account Manager informed of status, upcoming milestones, and changes to timeline or scope.
* Tracks project budget and flags overages or scope changes to the Account Manager.
* Makes sure contributors log their time to the correct project and task, since budget tracking, time reports, and invoicing depend on it.
* Collects reports from department leads when time on a task exceeds expectations, and passes them to the Account Manager with enough context to decide what should be invoiced.
* Routes out-of-scope client requests to the Account Manager, and does not schedule or begin the work until the Account Manager has approved the additional budget.

**Team Coordination**

* Collaborates with the project department leads to delegate tasks based on each contributor's expertise, availability, and capacity.
* Gets contributors the information and resources they need to complete their work without delay.
* Coordinates handoffs between internal departments, running the meetings and communication each one needs.
* Identifies opportunities for ad hoc collaboration across the team, connecting contributors who can help each other even when they do not regularly work together.
* Works with Managers to build project teams that meet the needs of each engagement.

**Client Communication**

* Serves as the client's day-to-day contact for project schedules, status, and deliverables.
* Schedules and leads project and client meetings, preparing agendas, documenting outcomes, and following up on action items.
* Generates required project reports, including status updates, monthly summaries of work delivered, and weekly time reports.
* Sets expectations with clients on timelines and deliverables, and brings in the Account Manager before discussing any change that affects scope or budget.
* Schedules and coordinates client demos, which the relevant department lead runs.
* Runs client review rounds, setting the review schedule and feedback deadlines and collecting the client's feedback in one place for the Project Strategist or department leads to act on.
* Confirms each deliverable is complete, has passed department lead review and QA, and has the Project Strategist's sign-off where one is assigned before it reaches the client.

**Launch & Closeout**

* Plans each launch with the department leads, including the go-live checklist, launch timing, and who is available to support it.
* Confirms the Account Manager has the client's written acceptance of the final deliverables before closing the project.
* Closes out the project, resolving or reassigning any open tasks.
* Transitions the project to support or a retainer, documenting what was delivered and what remains open, and explaining to the client how to submit requests going forward.

**Retainers & Support Queues**

* Plans the work for each retainer period with the client and department leads, within the hours agreed with the client.
* Tracks retainer hours used against each period's allotment and tells the Account Manager when a client is on pace to go over or under.
* Triages incoming support requests by severity and assigns each to the appropriate contributor.
* Keeps the client updated on open support requests until each one is resolved.
* Escalates urgent production issues to the relevant department
