jobs.description:
**Project Manager - 100% Remote**

  

**SUMMARY**:

  

The Project Manager is responsible for managing New Program Launches (NPLs) from initiation through completion and for continuously improving NPL processes. This individual serves as a key liaison across internal teams, including Partnership Services, Marketing, Enrollment Services, and Sales, and as a dedicated PM resource for university partners. The Project Manager also serves as the Onboarding lead for OnRamp, AllCampus’s new line of service offerings for prospective partners.

  

A core part of this role is applying AI to how launches get done. The Project Manager will identify, design, build, and scale AI-enabled workflows (such as automated status reporting, onboarding playbooks, meeting capture, and task tracking) that make NPL and OnRamp delivery faster, more consistent, and easier to scale as partner volume grows.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Project and launch management**

* Serves on the NPL Team and independently manages NPLs and OnRamp onboardings from initiation through delivery, ensuring launches are on time, within scope, and in line with stakeholder expectations
* Serves as the key facilitator between project teams, cross-functional departments, external vendors, and partners; leads project meetings, documents decisions and action items, and keeps stakeholders aligned on goals, deliverables, and timelines
* Develops and maintains comprehensive project plans and NPL and OnRamp production boards, tracking milestones and dependencies, updating workflows and timelines, and adjusting resources to resolve capacity constraints and launch risks
* Serves as the Onboarding lead for OnRamp, AllCampus’s new line of service offerings, guiding prospective partners from initial meetings and requirements gathering through internal system setup and launch
* Identifies potential roadblocks early, leads problem-solving sessions to drive resolution through collaboration, and escalates issues to the AVP, Operations when appropriate
* Conducts New Program Launch “lessons learned” meetings, and identifies and implements efficiency improvements, including AI and automation opportunities
* Partners with teams across the organization to lead process improvement initiatives and support documentation for Operations, Marketing, and partner program launches
* Manages the partner off-boarding process
* Serves as back-up to the Marketing Project Manager

**AI enablement and process efficiency**

* Identifies opportunities to apply AI across the NPL and OnRamp lifecycle, then designs, builds, and maintains AI-enabled workflows such as automated status updates, meeting summaries and action-item capture, requirements-gathering templates, and launch checklists
* Uses AI assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini) together with Smartsheet, Slack, Google Workspace, and the internal CRM to automate recurring reporting and reduce manual task tracking
* Builds and maintains a library of reusable AI prompts, templates, and documentation so NPL and OnRamp processes are repeatable and can be adopted by the broader team
* Contributes to the roadmap for automating and streamlining NPL and OnRamp processes, prioritizing improvements by impact and effort
* Measures the impact of AI-driven improvements (e.g., hours saved, launch cycle time, on-time delivery rate) and reports results to the AVP, Operations

* Performs other duties as assigned

  

**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE** **an equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.**

* Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred
* 3–5 years of project management, including independently managing complex, cross-functional projects; experience in higher education and client management preferred
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using generative AI tools to improve project management or operational workflows, including prompt design, validating AI outputs
* Experience building automations or integrations (e.g., Smartsheet automations, Zapier, Slack workflows, or API-based tools) strongly preferred
* Project management certification preferred; AI or automation certification a plus
* A collaborative approach and the ability to get cross-functional teams working toward the same goal
* Strong organizational skills and the flexibility to adapt when priorities or plans change
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence working with clients, leaders, consultants, and subject matter experts
* The ability to identify problems, facilitate decisions, and keep projects moving forward
* Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset; keeps current on emerging AI tools and evaluates where they add value

  

**COMPUTER SKILLS/TOOLS NEEDED TO PERFORM THE JOB** **which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.**

* Project management software and tools
* Proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and connecting them to everyday business systems
* Strong technical acumen; comfortable building and maintaining project workflows, creating initial internal program set up and automations in tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, the internal CRM system, and Regal (contact center platform)
* Solid working knowledge of Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and similar business tools

  

The salary range for this role is $80,000 - $95,000.

AllCampus is committed to creating a culture that is inclusive of race, age, gender or gender identity, ethnicity, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, physical ability, military veteran status and other backgrounds. We continually strive to grow and support our diverse employee population. Read our statement on Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

Check out our benefits! https://allcampus.com/benefits-guide/

**An in-person interview may be required.**

### **Department / Seat Name:** PMO

### **Role Summary**

The Project Manager (PM) plays a critical role in ensuring successful delivery of RSI Security’s cybersecurity and compliance engagements. The PM will lead the coordination, execution, and tracking of multiple client projects from kickoff through final deliverables, ensuring alignment across internal teams and client stakeholders. This role bridges Sales, Technical Operations, and the Client Experience team to drive execution and reinforce client trust throughout the engagement lifecycle.

  

### **Role Purpose**

The Project Manager at RSI Security is responsible for orchestrating the seamless execution of client-facing cybersecurity and compliance engagements. This role exists to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and to the highest standards of quality, while fostering trust and transparency with clients and internal teams. By aligning cross-functional efforts and driving operational discipline, the Project Manager plays a vital role in preserving client satisfaction, optimizing resource utilization, and reinforcing RSI Security’s reputation for excellence.

  

### **Core Responsibilities**

**Project Delivery & Execution**

* Own end-to-end project delivery: scope, timeline, resource coordination, and risk mitigation
* Facilitate project kickoffs, weekly status calls, and closeout activities
* Monitor project performance using KPIs and internal dashboards
* Ensure documentation, deliverables, and milestones are completed on time and to quality standards

**Client Experience & Communication**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution  
  Provide clear and proactive communication to manage expectations and enhance satisfaction
* Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on observed client needs

**Internal Collaboration**

* Coordinate with assessors, consultants, and technical SMEs to ensure aligned project delivery
* Work closely with the Sales and CX teams on pre-engagement planning and post-project review

* Ensure all activities comply with internal standards, client contracts, and industry best practices
* Maintain accurate records in project management tools (e.g., Monday.com, HubSpot)

Experience leading client kickoffs, weekly status calls, and escalations as the primary point of contact.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Enablement Program Manager to build and scale central enablement programs for a fast-moving sales organization. You'll own onboarding for new sales hires and ongoing upskilling for current teams. That covers the full cycle: creating content, scheduling and delivering training, then tracking readiness and acting on the results. You'll work with field leaders, regional enablement teams, Sales Operations, and subject matter experts. Your programs will reach new-hire cohorts of up to 20 people and wider initiatives covering 100 to 400 sales reps across new business acquisition and account management.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of central enablement programs that regional teams can adapt to local needs.
* Manage program roadmaps, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communications, prioritizing by field needs and business impact.
* Build and run role-based onboarding journeys for new sales hires, including learning paths, live sessions, practice exercises, and readiness assessments.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and cross-functional partners to create content, set training schedules, and run cohorts end to end, with clear milestones and manager guidance.
* Deliver parts of the training yourself as projects require.
* Build ongoing upskilling programs in discovery, value-based pitching, objection handling, closing, and account growth.
* Turn sales motions and methodologies into playbooks, talk tracks, talking points, collateral, mock calls, and certifications.
* Spot areas of low readiness and build refresher training and targeted improvement plans with stakeholders.
* Partner with sales managers to reinforce learning through coaching guides, practice, and follow-up activities.
* Develop and maintain eLearning, facilitator guides, quick reference guides, short videos, and toolkits, and keep content current and easy to find in Highspot.
* Work with tools and process owners to build workflow and process changes into onboarding and upskilling programs.
* Define and track program metrics, including training completion, call certification quality scores, ramp readiness against sales goals, and learner surveys. Report progress and recommendations to stakeholders.

* 7+ years in enablement, learning and development, sales operations, or a related program management role supporting sales teams. Candidates from a similar fast-paced, high-growth tech environment will be considered with 5+ years.

* A track record of building and running onboarding and upskilling programs, from needs assessment through delivery, measurement, and iteration.

* Comfort using data to define program metrics and judge program effectiveness. Familiarity with Salesforce and learning or content management platforms.

**Preferred**

**Customer Success Manager, Accounts & Retention**  
  
**About the Role**  
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you own a book of higher ed accounts from the welcome meeting through every renewal. You're the customer's main contact at Kuali and the person who knows their goals, their people, and how they actually use our products. You also own the renewal, so retention and growth in your book are yours to drive.  
  
This is an account management role. Product owns the roadmap and decides what gets built. Your part is to understand what each customer needs, bring that context to Product through our intake process, and keep the customer posted on what happens next. You don't need to know the roadmap by heart, and you won't be asked to make feature commitments.  
  
You also won't have every answer, especially in your first months. Customers will ask about integrations, data, and edge cases you haven't seen before. We want someone who's at ease saying they'll check, knows who to ask inside Kuali, and closes the loop with the customer quickly.  
  
The job is part relationship work and part operations. You'll spend time on calls and on campus, and you'll also work in Salesforce and ChurnZero tracking health scores, renewal dates, and next steps. You'll partner with Sales, Implementation, Support, and Product, and you'll bring the customer's view into each of those conversations.

**Who are we?**

Kuali builds software for colleges and universities. Our products cover forms and workflow (Build), emergency and continuity planning (Ready), curriculum and student systems (Student), research administration (Research), financials, and student outreach (Reach).Campus teams use Kuali to run work that used to live in paper, email, and spreadsheets.

**About you**

* **You align with Kuali’s values:** You are excited to contribute to an environment that reflects them.
* **You are detail-oriented:** You have an amazing attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
* **You are an amazing communicator:** You are a great listener and communication is clear, concise, and tailored to your audience. You possess strong editing skills.

* **You are able to multitask effectively:** You are good at working on multiple concurrent projects that sometimes have short turn-around times.
* **You are team oriented and set up for success on a remote team:** You love being helpful and supportive and thrive on the successes of the team. You’re comfortable being part of a fully remote team, and you have a suitable home working environment or alternative.

**What you’ll be responsible for**

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

**Role Overview:**

As an Onboarding Specialist, you're the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You'll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.

Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.

This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead Live Training.** Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
* **Support Customers Through Go-Live.** Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
* **Assist with Launch Readiness.** Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
* **Follow Up Proactively.** Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
* **Improve the Process.** Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experienced**. You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* **Effective Communicator**. You're a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
* **Customer-Focused**. You care about customers' outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
* **Organized and Dependable**. You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
* **Quick Learner**. You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you're still learning it.
* **Self-Directed**. You're comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team.

**Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have):**

* Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software (ChiroHD preferred)
* Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
* History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

**Why ChiroHD?**

**Impact & Growth:**

* Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
* PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
* Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
* High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
* Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

**Culture & Values:**

* Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
* Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
* High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results

new_jobs.description:
**Jr. Project Manager / Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer**

**Location:** San Francisco International Airport (SFO), San Francisco, CA  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Project-Based)  
**Work Schedule:** On-site minimum four (4) days per week  
**Industry:** Aviation Construction / Public Works Construction

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Jr. Project Manager** / **Project Site Administrator / Document Control / Office Engineer** to support a major construction project at San Francisco International Airport (SFO). This position will be responsible for project documentation management, compliance tracking, administrative coordination, and support of offsite warehouse, field, and project management teams.

The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale public works or government-funded construction projects and possess a strong understanding of construction documentation processes, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, pay applications, certified payroll reporting, and contract compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Documentation & Controls**

* Maintain and manage project document control systems in accordance with contract requirements.
* Coordinate and track:
  + Requests for Information (RFIs)
  + Submittals and shop drawing reviews
  + Change Orders and Potential Change Orders (PCOs)
  + Meeting minutes and action item logs
  + Contract correspondence and transmittals
* Ensure timely distribution, tracking, and archival of project documentation.
* Maintain current drawing, specification, and revision logs.

**Contract Administration Support**

* Assist Project Managers and Superintendents with contract compliance and documentation requirements.
* Support preparation and tracking of monthly owner pay applications through the collection of required documents such as lien waivers, supporting invoices, and releases needed from subcontractors and/or suppliers.
* Verify completeness of required documentation prior to invoice processing.
* Monitor compliance with project specifications and contractual reporting requirements.
* Responsible for taking meeting minutes and distributing to team members.

**Public Works & Labor Compliance**

* Administer certified payroll documentation in accordance with California prevailing wage requirements.
* Coordinate payroll reporting and labor compliance tracking using LCPtracker or equivalent systems.
* Support audits and requests from labor compliance officers, funding agencies, and project stakeholders.
* Maintain records related to prevailing wage compliance and subcontractor reporting.

**SFO Site Administration**

* Coordinate badging, security clearance, and access requests in accordance with SFO requirements.
* Assist project personnel, subcontractors, and visitors with airport access procedures.
* Maintain records of security training, badging status, and site access documentation.
* Collect and distribute subcontractors’ site daily reports.
* Interface with airport administrative staff regarding project documentation and compliance requirements.

**Software & Reporting**

* Maintain project records using:
  + Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + ProjectSight
  + Procore
* Generate project logs, status reports, document tracking reports, and compliance reports.
* Support project team meetings and reporting requirements.

**Warehouse Logistics & Material Documentation**

* Coordinate and maintain documentation related to project materials, equipment, and warehouse inventory supporting construction activities.
* Track material procurement, deliveries, receiving records, storage locations, and distribution to field crews.
* Maintain material status logs and reconcile delivery records against purchase orders, packing slips, and subcontractor requests.
* Coordinate documentation for off-site warehouse operations, including inventory tracking and material movement records.
* Track long-lead materials and critical equipment to support project schedules and installation milestones.
* Maintain chain-of-custody and accountability documentation for contractor-procured materials.
* Support project teams with material expediting reports, delivery schedules, warehouse inventory records, and shortage/damage reporting.
* Coordinate with procurement, field supervision, subcontractors, and warehouse personnel to ensure accurate and timely documentation of material logistics activities.
* Utilize project management platforms such as Procore and ProjectSight to maintain material tracking logs and warehouse documentation records.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in construction administration, document control, office engineering, or project coordination.
* Experience supporting commercial, infrastructure, aviation, transportation, or public works construction projects.
* Strong understanding of:
  + Construction submittal processes
  + Request for Information (RFI) workflows
  + Change Order administration
  + Project specifications and contract documents
  + Payment application and waiver documentation processes
* Experience with California public works and government-funded projects.
* Familiarity with California certified payroll requirements and prevailing wage compliance.
* Experience utilizing LCPtracker or similar labor compliance management systems.
* Experience with construction material management, warehouse logistics coordination, inventory tracking, and receiving documentation.
* Understanding of construction procurement workflows, material delivery coordination, and warehouse record management.
* Ability to maintain accurate material tracking logs and support project-level reporting for procurement and logistics activities.
* Must be able to pass a background check for badging at SFO.
* Proficiency with:
  + Microsoft Office Suite
  + Bluebeam Revu
  + Procore
  + ProjectSight

*

new_jobs.title: New Product Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Be visionary**

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

**Job Description**

**New Product Project Manager**
-------------------------------

Bring structure, urgency, and cross-functional coordination to new semiconductor product introductions. As a New Product Project Manager, you’ll guide assembly and test activities from design planning through design verification and production release, helping ensure new products move through manufacturing efficiently, meet quality expectations, and ship on schedule. You’ll partner closely with engineering, operations, materials, planning, customer service, and program management, with significant ownership and minimal supervision.

### **What you'll do**

* Plan and coordinate new-product assembly and test activities from design planning through production release.
* Develop build sequences, manufacturing schedules, milestones, and material requirements.
* Partner with engineering and program teams to ensure manufacturing requirements are accurately reflected in Material Requirements Planning systems.
* Coordinate with planners, operations, materials, and customer service to keep builds moving against commitments.
* Adjust schedules in response to design changes, material or labor constraints, backlogs, and other changing conditions.
* Identify schedule risks, expedite delayed activities, and coordinate mitigation plans.
* Track project status, milestones, schedule performance, risks, decisions, actions, and owners.
* Maintain accurate order, amendment, shipping, and project documentation.
* Help ensure products meet company quality standards and delivery commitments.

### **What you need**

* Strong project planning, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills - **required**
* Ability to manage changing priorities and work independently in a manufacturing environment - **required**
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience - **required**
* At least 5 years of directly related experience and/or training - **required**
* Semiconductor processing and radio frequency/microwave design or manufacturing experience - **preferred**
* Experience with MIL-STD-883 and basic knowledge of ISO and/or AS9100 - **preferred**
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen; Project Management Professional certification - **preferred**
* Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project proficiency, plus ability to travel domestically/internationally approximately 10% - **required**

### **What we offer**

An opportunity to take ownership of technically complex new-product builds, collaborate across engineering and manufacturing disciplines, and directly influence schedule, quality, and successful production release.

### **What happens next**

Submit your application for consideration. Details regarding the interview stages and candidate communications should be added once the recruiting process is confirmed.

*U.S. citizenship and the ability to attain and maintain a government security clearance are required. An active government security clearance is preferred. The role must follow applicable import/export requirements.*

**Salary Range:**

$141,900.00-$189,200.000

The anticipated salary range listed for this role is only an estimate. Actual compensation for successful candidates is carefully determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, location, local regulations (such as minimum wage), education/training, work experience, key skills, and type of position.

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Architecture & Automation Deployment
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

Agilent is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead the deployment of engineering tools, automation, and AI capabilities across our R&D organization. This role owns the full cycle from understanding what engineers actually need, to rolling out the tools and systems that meet that need, to making adoption stick. You will run internal voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions, translate what you learn into deployment programs, and drive the systematization and execution that turns a new tool or capability into something engineers actually use day to day.

This role also runs the program management behind Agilent's cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with our China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects. You will build and manage the program plans, governance, and reporting that keep divisional teams, the innovation hub, and the CTO office aligned as these initiatives scale.

This is a program leadership role built for someone who can move fluidly between listening to engineers, structuring a rollout plan, and running the execution discipline to deliver it. A systems engineering background is highly valued: understanding how engineering tools plug into the product development lifecycle and being able to speak credibly with engineering leads about technical workflows, will make you far more effective than program management experience alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Voice of Customer and Tool Strategy**

* Run structured voice-of-customer efforts with engineering teams across divisions to understand where new tools, automation, or AI capabilities would have the most impact.
* Synthesize findings into clear deployment priorities and business cases, partnering with engineering leadership to validate direction.
* Stay current on emerging engineering tools and AI capabilities relevant to hardware and systems engineering workflows.

**Architecture and AI Deployment**

* Own end-to-end deployment programs for architecture implementation and AI capabilities across the enterprise, from pilot through full rollout.
* Drive systematization: turning a promising tool or pilot into a repeatable, well-governed capability that scales across divisions.
* Partner with IT, engineering operations, and divisional leads to manage rollout logistics, training, and change management.
* Track adoption and usage post-deployment, and course-correct programs that aren't landing.

**Automation Program Execution**

* Lead program management for cross-divisional automation initiatives, including coordination with the China Innovation Center on accelerated engineering projects.
* Build and run program plans, governance cadences, and status reporting that keep divisional teams, strategic marketing, and the hub aligned on scope and timing.
* Manage cross-time zone program cadence with the China Innovation Center, keeping risks and dependencies visible to stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Governance and Reporting**

* Maintain a portfolio view across architecture and automation programs, including status, risks, resourcing, and timelines.
* Partner with divisional program managers and engineering leads to resolve cross-program dependencies.
* Report program health and key decisions to the CTO office and other senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years of program or project management experience in a hardware/instrument R&D environment, including experience deploying tools, processes, or capabilities across engineering teams.
* Systems engineering background or hands-on experience working within a systems engineering process strongly preferred.
* Experience running voice-of-customer or internal stakeholder research efforts and translating findings into action.
* Experience with engineering tool rollouts, digital transformation, or AI/automation adoption initiatives strongly preferred.
* Experience running cross-divisional or multi-site programs, ideally including work with an offshore or globally distributed engineering team.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong program and portfolio management fundamentals: scope, schedule, risk, and stakeholder management.

new_jobs.title: Intensive Care Coordinator – Youth & Family Mental Health
new_jobs.description:
WestCoast Children's Clinic, located in Oakland, California, is a non-profit community psychology clinic that provides mental health services to Bay Area children, youth and families. ***Working at WestCoast Children's Clinic means being part of an organization that is client-centered, trauma-informed, collaborative, and committed to justice and equity.***

**Outpatient and C-Change Intensive Care Coordinator (ICC)**

**Position Details**

* **Classification:** Regular Full Time (1.0 FTE), Non-exempt (Hourly)
* **Location:** Oakland, CA / Hybrid (client services are provided in person; documentation can be completed remotely)
* **Schedule:** Full time, Monday–Friday
* **Pay:** $34.62 per hour

**Our Program: C-Change**

C-Change works with youth who are at risk of, or have been identified as, sexually exploited minors, helping them transform their lives. The program focuses on stabilization, reducing mental health symptoms, building self-efficacy and self-determination, creating community, and connecting youth to additional resources. Our specialized model includes mental health screening, advocacy, clinical case management, and psychotherapy for at-risk youth. We serve young people up to age 21 who live throughout the Bay Area.

**The Position**

The ICC will work mainly with youth and young adults in C-Change. The role was is also referred to as a Mental Health Care Coordinator.

You will be responsible for assessing clients and for developing, coordinating, carrying out, and overseeing intensive, community-based behavioral health care plans. Clients have moderate to high acuity and complex needs that may be behavioral, medical, developmental, and/or psychosocial.

Each youth is supported by a Child & Family Team (CFT) that you will assemble and lead. The team draws on family, natural supports such as friends, extended family, neighbors, and community members, and formal system partners such as child welfare, schools, and juvenile probation, all working together toward the youth's goals and toward lasting change. You will coordinate and facilitate regular CFT meetings and both monitor and contribute to the youth's progress.

Guided by the Integrated Core Practice Model, you will use clinical judgment and discretion, in partnership with the team, to evaluate strengths and needs, choose interventions, coordinate services across disciplines, manage crises, link clients to resources, build behavioral skills, and design individualized care strategies.

The work is varied. It involves interpreting clinical information, applying professional standards, and making clinically informed decisions. You'll provide services and attend agency meetings virtually (Zoom or phone), in the office, and in community settings such as our drop-in center, client homes, schools, and parks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Assessment and care plans:** Perform comprehensive biopsychosocial, behavioral health, risk, and functional assessments for clients with complex, high-acuity needs. Contribute to building, implementing, and tracking individualized care plans that use evidence-based and trauma-informed approaches. Assess clinical progress over time and change interventions as your ongoing assessment and professional judgment indicate.
* **CFT facilitation:** Set up, organize, and run CFT meetings regularly with youth, families, and their community partners. Facilitation training is provided.
* **Caseload and direct services:** Manage up to 19 clients, with 50% of your time (20 hours per week) spent providing behavioral health services to youth and families. This includes assessing strengths and needs, connecting youth to resources, supporting skill building, and providing crisis intervention and de-escalation, while producing high-quality documentation.
* **Crisis response:** Assess and respond to behavioral health crises, safety concerns, and urgent situations, both independently and alongside colleagues. Decide on appropriate interventions, escalation steps, mandated reporting, and emergency referrals using professional judgment.
* **Documentation and billing:** Write daily progress notes and complete other clinical documentation in line with WCC policies and procedures for EPSDT Medi-Cal and other billing requirements. You should know Medi-Cal reimbursement and billing procedures or be able to learn them.
* **Teamwork:** Collaborate with enthusiasm as a member of a multidisciplinary treatment team, helping youth and families set goals and move toward them.
* **Ethics and mission:** Meet all ethical and legal responsibilities, including those of a mandated reporter, and represent our mission and philosophy.

**What We're Looking For**

*Required:*

* At least 2 years of professional, direct work with children and/or families using a mental health framework, in behavioral health, care coordination, intensive case management, social services, healthcare coordination, or related clinical services.
* Demonstrated experience with adolescents/minors who have a dual diagnosis, high mental health needs, and/or have experienced child sexual exploitation (CSE).
* Experience and skill facilitating groups, trainings, or treatment teams.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Counseling, or a related field. Significant relevant professional experience in mental health or behavioral health services may be considered instead of a degree.
* A vehicle, current car insurance, and a clean California DMV record. Travel by car to meet clients is required, generally within 90 miles of the WCC office.
* Availability for evenings and occasional weekends as needed.

*Skills and qualities:*

* Strong crisis assessment and intervention skills, and sound professional judgment when situations are unclear or changing.
* Passion for working with foster youth, families, and young adults with complex trauma histories.
* Strong motivation to work within a team-based approach.

new_jobs.title: DESIGNER AND PROJECT COORDINATOR
new_jobs.description:
**Olczak Group · Berkeley, CA · Full time, in office, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM · $45 to $55 per hour**

Read this first. This role is in person at our Berkeley studio, five days a week, 8:30 to 5:30 with an hour for lunch. It is paid hourly. If that works for you, keep reading.

We are a licensed architecture practice and a licensed general contractor under one roof, with our own build team. Our work is high end residential in the Bay Area: ground up new homes, gut renovations, and remodels, with budgets that run into the millions. See our work at olczakgroup.com and olczakbuild.com. This seat is two jobs in one. You are the studio's Revit and visualization expert, producing the models, drawing sets, and images behind every project. You are also the coordinator who keeps project information moving so our Project Leads can lead. It is also the seat we promote from. Within your first year you will lead a small project of your own, such as a kitchen, a bath, or a backyard studio, with a Project Lead signing off at each gate.

**What you will do**

Design and production

* Build and maintain the Revit model for each project, from existing conditions through construction documents, under the direction of a Project Lead.
* Produce drawing sets that pass our written quality review the first time.
* Own the studio's Revit standards: templates, families, and the habits that keep models clean.
* Create the renderings and visualizations we use to present designs to clients.
* Contribute design work of your own: studies, options, and details.
* Measure and document existing conditions in the field.

Coordination

* Keep the logs current every day: submittals, RFIs, client selections, and bid tracking.
* Assemble bid packages from our templates, send them to subcontractors, chase the responses, and file them where they belong.
* Take meeting notes, turn them into action items the same day, and follow up until each one is closed.
* Track orders and lead times so nothing lands late on site.
* Support permit submittals: forms, sheets, and the response to comments.
* Keep project files organized to our written standard.

**What the work is really like**

This seat is about 65 percent design and production and 35 percent coordination, and both parts count. One day you are deep in a model. The next you are sending the third email and updating a log. People who want only to design will resent the follow up. People who want only to coordinate will not keep up in Revit. We are looking for the person who likes both, and who wants to run a project of their own.

**Who this fits**

* You hold a degree in architecture.
* You have five or more years of production experience in Revit, and you are the person others ask when a model breaks.
* You produce client ready renderings in V-Ray and Enscape, and your portfolio shows it.
* You have a designer's eye and can develop an idea into a buildable detail.
* You are organized in a way other people can see: your files, your notes, your inbox.
* You communicate before you are asked. If something will be late, we hear it from you first.

**What you get**

* $45 to $55 per hour, with overtime paid.
* A defined path. You lead your first small project within your first year, and we review your progress toward Designer Builder, the next seat up, at twelve months, against written criteria.
* Daily exposure to both design and construction, in the same room as the people doing each.
* Written standards for nearly everything you will be asked to do.
* PTO on accrual basis (per hour worked) for a maximum of 10 days per calendar year @ 40 hrs / week.
* Opportunities for continuing education in building science, architecture, materials, and detailing
* A positive work culture grounded in mutual respect, accountability, and integrity
* Employer subsidized healthcare benefits

**How to apply**

Email your resume and portfolio to careers@olczakgroup.com. The portfolio should include drawing sheets and renderings you produced yourself, with your role stated on each. Use the subject line "Designer and Project Coordinator" followed by your name, and tell us the earliest date you could start. In the body of the email, answer these two questions in 150 words or fewer each:

1.What is the most disorganized project or situation you have inherited, and what did you do first?

2.What is one system you built to keep track of things, and how do you know it works?

Applications without both answers will not be reviewed. Finalists complete a short paid Revit exercise.

Olczak Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay: $45.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

**Drive Manager Accountability & New-Hire Readiness**

* Define clear expectations and milestones for new hires and their managers throughout the onboarding journey.

* Monitor learner progression and identify where intervention, additional coaching or program changes are needed.
* Ensure readiness decisions reflect demonstrated capability across the 30/60/90-day journey, not simply content completion.

**Measure Impact & Drive Program Evolution**

* Own program measurement across participation, completion, learner experience, readiness, manager engagement and time-to-productivity.
* Partner with Operations/RevOps to connect onboarding data to downstream business outcomes such as pipeline contribution and ramp.
* Establish structured feedback loops and translate insights into a prioritized program roadmap.
* Continuously evolve and scale the program based on data, stakeholder input and changing business priorities.

**What Great Looks Like**

while maintaining ownership of the overall outcome.

**About the job**
-----------------

**Cuttable exists because creativity shouldn’t be what slows marketing teams down.**

The world’s biggest advertising platforms demand more ads than most teams can produce. But production is still slow, expensive and built for a different era. Briefs pile up. Creative teams burn out. Marketers can’t keep up.

Cuttable fixes that.

We’re an AI Creative Production System that helps ecommerces brands create, test and launch ads across Meta, TikTok and Google at the volume the platforms actually reward.

More than 300 brands across North America and Asia Pacific already use Cuttable. We’re backed by Square Peg, Rampersand and AirTree, following one of the largest seed rounds in Australian tech history. Offices in Melbourne and New York.

Our CEO and co-founder, Sam Kroonenburg, has built and scaled a global technology company before. Now we’re doing it again.

**Join us and help make good ads, instantly.**

**The role**
------------

**Pay range: $68,000 – $102,000 USD per year** - Equity is included in every offer.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Specialist to become the face of customer support for Cuttable in Australia and the US, and help grow the function as we scale in Melbourne and San Francisco. This isn’t just about answering tickets. It’s about building a world-class support experience that delights customers, scales with us, and becomes a real competitive advantage.

You’ll be one of the first people in this role across Australia and the US, which means you’ll help set the standard for how we support Australian and American brands: handling incoming queries, solving problems fast, and building out the processes, tools and knowledge base that help our customers succeed at scale.

We want someone who’s customer-obsessed: the kind of person who leans in, gets curious, and is as excited about solving problems as our customers are about creating great ads. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a startup environment: hands-on, resourceful, and excited to have an impact from zero to one.

You’ll report to the Customer Success Director and work closely with our Customer Success Managers. This role is based in Melbourne (flexible hybrid, with in-person collaboration encouraged).

**What you’ll own**

* Being the first point of contact for all customer support queries via Intercom (and other channels as we grow), with a strong focus on fast turnaround: first response typically within 5 minutes, ongoing replies within 10 minutes, and every chat picked up within 3 minutes.
* Triaging, troubleshooting and resolving day-to-day platform, billing and account queries, balancing fast response with genuine care. Every ticket is a chance to build trust, not just close a queue.
* Support documentation, FAQs and video walkthroughs that let customers self-serve, keeping the knowledge base current as the product changes.

* Definition and refinement of support processes, tools and playbooks to make the function more scalable as ticket volume grows, as one of the first people building it across Australia and the US.
* Tracking and reporting on key support metrics (response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction) so the team has real visibility into how support is performing.

**Who you’ll support**

* Product and Engineering, by capturing and sharing customer insights, recurring pain points and feature requests straight from the front line. You’ll read patterns in the queue, not just individual tickets.
* CSMs and Implementation Managers, with day-to-day platform, creative and general support queries, so they can stay focused on activation and account health.
* The wider GTM team, as an internal advocate for customers, always pushing for the best possible experience and flagging the right things to AEs, CSMs, Implementation Managers and Product without waiting to be asked.

### **Who we look for**

* **Be Brave & Own It**: you take smart risks and you own what happens next, good or bad. You own the outcome, not just the intention.

* **Progress Beats Perfection**: you’d rather ship, learn, and improve than sit on something waiting for it to be flawless.
* **Work Hard, Laugh Often**: you take the work seriously. Never yourself.

We believe you’ll succeed in this role if you have:

* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain things clearly, simply, and with a bit of personality.
* A proactive, resourceful streak. You don’t just solve the problem, you prevent it from happening again.

### **About the Role**

* Run programs by segment: Execute plays and campaigns for each customer segment and outcome that drive increasing value from CaptivateIQ over time, with consistent, high-quality follow-through.

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife — and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need better visibility into how work moves through our inboxes, how our teams perform, and how to deploy our workforce efficiently.

We're looking for a **Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning** to build and own the analytical and workforce planning capabilities that power our Async Operations organization.

This person will design and establish the metrics, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that help us understand demand, throughput, productivity, service levels, and cost. You'll turn complex operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make better decisions every day.

You'll work closely with Async Operations leaders to identify what's driving SLA performance, where work is getting stuck, how much capacity we need, and where we can improve productivity or eliminate unnecessary work. You'll independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and influence decisions about staffing, workflows, and technology investments.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, and comfortable independently exploring complex datasets. They're excited to use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, build models, and solve operational problems. They can translate data into clear recommendations that help leaders make better staffing, workflow, and operational decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building analytical capabilities from the ground up and using data to drive operational change.

**The goal:** Deliver an excellent patient experience while continuously improving throughput, workforce efficiency, and cost per visit.

You won't just report on how the inbox is performing - you'll help us figure out how to make it perform better.

**What you'll do**

**Operational Analytics & Performance**

* Design and own the analytics and reporting framework for Async Operations, providing visibility into volume, throughput, turnaround times, backlogs, productivity, and SLAs.
* Build dashboards, reporting, and recurring analyses that help leaders understand operational performance and take action.
* Establish consistent definitions and measurement frameworks for key inbox metrics across teams and workflows.
* Analyze how work moves through the inbox, including incoming volume, completed work, aging, handoffs, and bottlenecks.

* Develop and own the analytical approach to understanding, monitoring, and improving SLA performance across inbox workflows.

* Recommend and help prioritize operational interventions based on expected impact, feasibility, and resource requirements.

**Productivity & Cost Optimization**

* Develop and own the measurement frameworks for productivity, cost per completed action, and async cost per visit.
* Identify opportunities to increase throughput, reduce unnecessary work, and improve workforce efficiency.

new_jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Us:**

We're not just another SaaS company. We're chiropractors and software veterans who got tired of watching practices struggle with clunky, outdated systems. So we built something better.

ChiroHD (https://www.chirohd.com/) is the cloud-based practice management platform that actually gets chiropractic. Scheduling, EHR, billing, patient communication - everything a modern practice needs, built specifically for how chiropractors actually work. No more trying to force-fit horizontal software into your vertical world. We've cracked the code on product-market fit - prepped, proven, and ready for scale!

**Role Overview:**

As an Onboarding Specialist, you're the first person our new customers work with after they sign, and you set the tone for their entire experience with us. You'll lead live kickoff and training calls, provide guidance and support as customers work through their own account setup, and help ensure they feel confident and prepared to use the product by the time they go live.

Our onboarding process is primarily self-guided, meaning customers are responsible for completing their own setup, while you serve as a trusted resource to answer questions, provide direction, and help them navigate the process successfully.

This is a customer-focused, hands-on role on a growing onboarding team. Your work directly impacts how quickly customers become successful with our product and their long-term satisfaction and retention.

**What You'll Do**

* **Lead Live Training.** Run kickoff and training calls that introduce new customers to the onboarding process, explain setup expectations, and demonstrate how to use the product in their day-to-day operations.
* **Support Customers Through Go-Live.** Serve as a resource throughout the customer-led onboarding process, providing guidance, answering questions, setting clear expectations, and helping customers stay on track toward a successful launch.
* **Assist with Launch Readiness.** Provide guidance on account configuration and complete light configuration tasks when needed to support a successful go-live, while ensuring customers remain responsible for their own account setup.
* **Follow Up Proactively.** Reach out to customers who are stalled or struggling, offer assistance when needed, and flag early signs of risk to your manager.
* **Improve the Process.** Keep onboarding records accurate and current, and share customer feedback and recurring friction points with the team so we can continuously improve the onboarding experience.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experienced**. You have 1–3 years of experience in SaaS onboarding, implementation, or a similar customer-facing role.
* **Effective Communicator**. You're a confident, friendly communicator who can lead a live training call and make a non-technical person feel capable.
* **Customer-Focused**. You care about customers' outcomes, not just finishing the checklist. You want them to be using the product and getting value from it.
* **Organized and Dependable**. You can manage a full caseload of clinics at different stages without losing track of next steps or commitments.
* **Quick Learner**. You pick up new software quickly and can explain it simply, even when you're still learning it.
* **Self-Directed**. You're comfortable working remotely, taking feedback, and sharing what you learn with the team.

**Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have):**

* Hands-on experience in a medical practice or with EHR software (ChiroHD preferred)
* Experience using Customer Success tools like Gainsight or ChurnZero
* History of supporting small business customers directly
* Proven ability to document, refine, and improve workflows
* Skillful at using AI tools to boost efficiency and productivity

**Non-Negotiables (Disqualifiers):**

* Lacks prior experience in SaaS onboarding or software implementation
* Lacks customer-facing experience conducting live training or kickoff calls
* Unable to work standard working hours in Central or Eastern Time

**Why ChiroHD?**

**Impact & Growth:**

* Vertical SaaS category leader in a wide market.
* PE-backed with $26M in growth capital to scale aggressively.
* Established product-market fit; scaling outbound-led growth engine now.
* High-caliber sales culture focused on coaching, commercial excellence, and real career growth.
* Direct leadership access, no bureaucracy, high visibility.

**Culture & Values:**

* Customer-obsessed team that puts patient care at the center of everything we do
* Low-ego, builder-first environment where the best ideas win
* High-accountability culture with emphasis on ownership and results
* Commitment to work-life balance and professional development

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible PTO and remote-first culture
